process: Step 1: Obtain the official free application form during statewide 'Duare Sarkar' camps or from your BDO office.
Step 2: Fill in applicant's Name, Swasthya Sathi Card number, Aadhaar number, and Date of Birth.
Step 3: Attach photocopies of Swasthya Sathi card, Aadhaar card, SC/ST certificate (if applicable), and Bank Passbook.
Step 4: Submit at the dedicated Lakshmir Bhandar counter at the Duare Sarkar camp.
Step 5: Official scans your form, assigns a unique Application Registration Number, and hands over the tear-off receipt.
Step 6: Block Development Officer (BDO) verifies records on the state portal.
Step 7: District Magistrate approves the sanction order.
Step 8: Monthly cash benefit (₹1,000 or ₹1,200) is credited directly into your bank account via DBT.
Step 9: Receive monthly SMS notification when the amount is credited.

faqs.q: How much money is given under Lakshmir Bhandar?
faqs.a: In February 2024, the West Bengal Government enhanced the benefit to ₹1,200 per month for SC/ST women and ₹1,000 per month for General and OBC women.

faqs.q: What happens when a woman turns 60 years old?
faqs.a: Upon reaching 60 years of age, she automatically transitions to the state Old Age Pension without needing to file a fresh application, continuing to receive ₹1,000/month for life.

faqs.q: Can a woman without a Swasthya Sathi card apply?
faqs.a: You can apply for your Swasthya Sathi card and Lakshmir Bhandar together at the same Duare Sarkar camp.

faqs.q: Is there any income limit to get Lakshmir Bhandar?
faqs.a: No! There is no family income limit. The scheme is universal for all women not in government employment.

faqs.q: Can married and unmarried women both apply?
faqs.a: Yes, all adult women between 25 and 60 years of age who reside in West Bengal are eligible.

faqs.q: Are any fees charged for the application form?
faqs.a: No! The form is distributed 100% free with a unique barcode at Duare Sarkar camps. Beware of touts selling forms.

purpose: Lakshmir Bhandar is the flagship universal social protection initiative of the Government of West Bengal, delivering unconditional monthly basic income support to all adult female heads of households, strengthening women's financial independence and supporting domestic consumption.
targetBeneficiary: Adult women residents of West Bengal aged 25 to 60 years listed on Swasthya Sathi or Khadya Sathi ration cards.
financialBenefit: ₹1,200/month for SC/ST women; ₹1,000/month for General & OBC women (directly credited via monthly DBT)
benefitFrequency: Monthly direct bank transfer
impact: Covers over 2 crore women across West Bengal, creating a permanent economic safety net, boosting rural household spending, and ensuring universal dignity.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: NO family income ceiling (universal for all non-taxpayer women).
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Homemaker, informal worker, agricultural laborer, self-employed, etc.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all castes (SC/ST receive higher ₹1,200/month; General/OBC receive ₹1,000/month).
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Covered per adult woman.

mandatoryConditions: Must be an adult woman aged 25 to 60 years residing in West Bengal
Must possess a valid Swasthya Sathi card or Khadya Sathi Digital Ration Card
Must hold an individual bank account seeded with Aadhaar
Neither applicant nor family should be in regular government employment or receiving government pension
conditionalRequirements: SC/ST certificate required to claim the higher ₹1,200/month rate.
ineligibility: Women who are permanent government employees in Central, State, local bodies, or government-aided institutions
Women receiving regular government pensions
Women below 25 years or above 60 years of age
applicationMode: In-person at 'Duare Sarkar' Camps & BDO / Municipal Ward Offices
offlineProcess: Visit the Duare Sarkar camp organized in your village or municipal ward. Government staff provide the official application form with unique serial numbers free of cost.
commonMistakes: Using photocopied/unofficial blank forms: The government requires official numbered forms distributed at Duare Sarkar camps.
Bank account in husband's name: Account must strictly be in the woman applicant's own individual name.
Bank account not linked to Aadhaar: Causes DBT payment failure.
processingTime: First payment credited within 30 to 45 days of camp verification.
renewalRequired: No renewal needed; automatically transitions to Old Age Pension upon reaching 60 years.
trackingProcedure: Check status on socialsecurity.wb.gov.in using Swasthya Sathi card number or Aadhaar number.
correctionProcedure: Visit your local BDO or Municipal office to update bank passbook details.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Woman's Bank Account via WB State Treasury
disbursementDetails: West Bengal Finance Department transfers funds directly from the state treasury into the woman's savings bank account on the first week of every month.
helpline: Lakshmir Bhandar Helpline: 1800-345-5654 or Nabanna Helpdesk: 033-22143526

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
department: Women & Child Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
applyChannel: camps organised by Gram Panchayat / ward offices
description: Monthly financial assistance for women in Madhya Pradesh.
whoCanApply: Married women (including widowed, divorced, abandoned) aged 21–60, MP residents, with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh and no income-tax payer in the family.
benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹1,250 per month (enhanced from ₹1,000, with government commitment to raise to ₹3,000 in phases) transferred directly into the woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account on the 10th of every month.
deadlineInfo: Accepted during announced camp rounds; online portal open for tracking.

rules.label: No income-tax payer in the family

documents.name: Samagra Family ID & Individual Member ID
documents.why: MP government universal citizen registry number.
documents.issuingAuthority: Panchayat & Rural Development / Urban Administration, MP

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant Woman
documents.why: Identity verification and biometric e-KYC.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook Copy
documents.why: For receiving ₹1,250 monthly credit via DBT.
documents.format: Passbook copy showing Account Number and IFSC

process: Step 1: Ensure your Samagra ID e-KYC is complete on samagra.gov.in using Aadhaar OTP.
Step 2: Attend the Ladli Behna registration camp in your Gram Panchayat or Ward.
Step 3: Provide your Samagra ID, Aadhaar number, and active mobile number.
Step 4: Camp operator captures your live photograph and submits details on cmladlibehna.mp.gov.in.
Step 5: Collect the printed Acknowledgement Receipt with your Application Reference Number.
Step 6: Provisional beneficiary list is published in the Gram Panchayat / Ward for public scrutiny.
Step 7: Once final approval is issued, ₹1,250 is credited directly into your bank account on the 10th of every month.
Step 8: Receive SMS alert from the Madhya Pradesh Treasury upon credit.

faqs.q: On what day of the month is the money credited?
faqs.a: The ₹1,250 amount is deposited directly into the beneficiary's bank account on the 10th of every calendar month.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for Ladli Behna Yojana?
faqs.a: The woman must be between 21 and 60 years of age.

faqs.q: Can unmarried women apply?
faqs.a: No, the scheme is for married, widowed, divorced, or separated women residing in Madhya Pradesh.

faqs.q: What should I do if my money is not deposited on the 10th?
faqs.a: Log in to cmladlibehna.mp.gov.in with your Samagra ID to see the reason, and check with your bank branch whether Aadhaar DBT seeding is active.

faqs.q: Is any paper application form required?
faqs.a: No paper form is needed; the camp operator enters your Samagra ID and completes electronic registration on the spot.

faqs.q: Can a family owning a tractor apply?
faqs.a: Yes. Families owning an agricultural tractor are permitted, but personal four-wheeler ownership disqualifies the applicant.

purpose: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana, launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides unconditional monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 to women in Madhya Pradesh, fostering economic self-reliance, supporting family nutrition, and recognizing women's role in the household.
targetBeneficiary: Married, widowed, divorced, or abandoned women residents of Madhya Pradesh aged 21 to 60 years.
financialBenefit: ₹1,250 per month (₹15,000 per year) directly credited via monthly DBT on the 10th of each month
benefitFrequency: Monthly direct bank transfer
impact: Reaches over 1.29 crore women across Madhya Pradesh, promoting health, maternal nutrition, micro-entrepreneurship, and decision-making power.

detailedEligibility.genderRequirement: Strictly Female applicant (married, widowed, divorced, or abandoned).
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Total family annual income must NOT exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Informal workers, agricultural laborers, self-employed women, and homemakers.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all castes and categories.
detailedEligibility.residenceRequirement: Permanent resident / domicile of Madhya Pradesh.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Family land holding must be less than 5 acres; family must not own four-wheelers (tractors exempted).

mandatoryConditions: Must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh aged between 21 and 60 years
Family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000
Must hold a verified Samagra Family ID and Individual Samagra ID with completed e-KYC
Must have an active individual bank account seeded with Aadhaar on the NPCI DBT mapper
conditionalRequirements: Samagra e-KYC must be completed via Aadhaar OTP or biometric scan before application.
ineligibility: Families where total annual income exceeds ₹2,50,000
Families where any member pays income tax
Families with regular/contractual government employees or pensioners
Families owning more than 5 acres of agricultural land
Families owning a four-wheeler (except agricultural tractor)
Unmarried women (scheme is for married, widowed, divorced, or separated women)
applicationMode: Special In-Person Camps organized at Gram Panchayats & Municipal Ward Offices across MP
offlineProcess: Registration is conducted through camps at local Gram Panchayat offices, Anganwadi centres, and Ward offices. Camp operators take live photographs and submit the form free of charge.
commonMistakes: Samagra e-KYC not completed: You must complete Aadhaar e-KYC on the Samagra portal before the camp operator can accept your application.
Bank account not active for DBT: Payment will fail if the bank account is not mapped on the NPCI server.
Family land holding above 5 acres: Land records integrated with Samagra automatically flag holdings over 5 acres.
openingDate: March 2023; active with ongoing monthly credits
processingTime: Sanctioned within 30 days of camp verification.
renewalRequired: No monthly renewal needed; deposits continue on the 10th of every month.
trackingProcedure: Track application and payment status on cmladlibehna.mp.gov.in under 'Application & Payment Status'.
correctionProcedure: Visit your local Gram Panchayat Secretary or Ward Office to resolve bank account issues.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Woman's Bank Account via MP State Treasury
disbursementDetails: The Government of Madhya Pradesh deposits ₹1,250 directly into the woman's Aadhaar-linked savings account on the 10th of every calendar month.

name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi – KASP (Kerala)
department: State Health Agency, Government of Kerala
description: Kerala's health assurance scheme, integrated with PM-JAY, for eligible families.
whoCanApply: Families listed under PM-JAY / RSBY and those notified by the state (e.g., priority ration card holders).
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 650+ empanelled government and private hospitals in Kerala, covering 1,600+ surgical and medical procedures.
deadlineInfo: Continuous rolling enrolment. No deadline.

rules.label: Family listed in the KASP beneficiary database

documents.name: Kerala Priority Ration Card (Yellow / Pink Card)
documents.why: Proof of eligibility under BPL/Priority household criteria.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Identity verification and biometric authentication.

process: Step 1: Check your eligibility on sha.kerala.gov.in using your Ration Card number.
Step 2: Visit any Akshaya Centre in Kerala with your Ration Card and Aadhaar Card.
Step 3: The Akshaya operator performs biometric e-KYC and issues your KASP-Ayushman Card.
Step 4: Show the card at the KASP Helpdesk (KASP Kiosk) inside any empanelled hospital in Kerala for cashless admission.

faqs.q: What is KASP?
faqs.a: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP) is Kerala's flagship health insurance scheme providing up to ₹5,00,000 cashless hospitalisation cover to eligible families.

faqs.q: Can I get my KASP card made at an Akshaya Centre?
faqs.a: Yes, all Akshaya Centres across Kerala are authorized to register beneficiaries and print KASP-Ayushman cards.

faqs.q: Are emergency admissions covered without prior referral?
faqs.a: Yes, genuine emergency and acute life-threatening hospitalisations are covered immediately without referrals.

faqs.q: Does KASP cover kidney dialysis?
faqs.a: Yes, free outpatient dialysis packages are covered under KASP at government and empanelled private centers.

faqs.q: Are prescription medicines provided after discharge?
faqs.a: Yes, package guidelines mandate up to 15 days of free discharge medicines for patients.

faqs.q: What should I do if an empanelled hospital demands payment?
faqs.a: Immediately contact the DISHA helpline at 1056 or lodge a grievance with the State Health Agency.

purpose: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP) is Kerala's unified state health insurance initiative that integrates PM-JAY and state welfare funds to deliver comprehensive, quality cashless hospitalisation cover to vulnerable and low-income families in Kerala.
targetBeneficiary: Poor and vulnerable families in Kerala listed under BPL/priority ration cards, previous RSBY beneficiaries, and state-certified low-income households.
financialBenefit: Up to ₹5,00,000 cashless hospitalisation cover per family per year
benefitFrequency: Annual floating family coverage
impact: Prevents high out-of-pocket health expenditure in Kerala, provides cashless access to advanced medical technology, cardiology, neurology, and oncology.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: BPL and priority household threshold as determined by Kerala Civil Supplies.
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Informal, agricultural, and unorganized sector workers.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: All categories.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Family members listed on priority/BPL ration card.

mandatoryConditions: Must be a resident of Kerala holding a valid Pink or Yellow Priority Ration Card
Must be registered in the KASP / PM-JAY database
Must present KASP / Ayushman Card and Aadhaar at empanelled hospital kiosk
conditionalRequirements: Referral from government hospital for select advanced private hospital tertiary care procedures.
ineligibility: Kerala Government employees and pensioners covered under MEDISEP
High-income families holding Non-Priority White ration cards (unless covered under specific state welfare boards)
Un-empanelled hospitals
applicationMode: Online via sha.kerala.gov.in / Akshaya Centres & Offline at Empanelled Hospitals
offlineProcess: Visit your local Akshaya Centre or the KASP Helpdesk at any Medical College, District Hospital, or empanelled private hospital in Kerala with your ration card and Aadhaar.
commonMistakes: Not completing e-KYC at Akshaya centre: Having an eligible ration card is not enough; the individual KASP card must be generated.
Assuming MEDISEP and KASP are the same: MEDISEP is for government employees and pensioners; KASP is for low-income citizens.
processingTime: Instantaneous card generation at Akshaya; hospital pre-authorisation within 1 hour.
renewalRequired: Auto-renews annually on 1st April.
trackingProcedure: Check status on sha.kerala.gov.in or call 1056.
correctionProcedure: Update family details on the civil supplies portal (civilsupplieskerala.gov.in).
disbursementMethod: 100% Cashless Inpatient Hospitalisation Settlement
disbursementDetails: Hospital submits e-preauthorization to the State Health Agency (SHA) Kerala. Expenses are settled directly between SHA and the hospital.
helpline: DISHA / KASP Helpline: 1056 (Toll-Free in Kerala) or 0471-2552056

name: Rajiv Aarogyasri (Telangana)
department: Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Government of Telangana
description: Cashless treatment for listed procedures for eligible Telangana families.
whoCanApply: Telangana families holding a white ration card / food security card.
benefits: Comprehensive cashless hospitalisation coverage up to ₹10,00,000 per family per year (enhanced by the Telangana Government in December 2023 from ₹5 Lakh) covering 1,672 medical and surgical procedures across empanelled network hospitals in Telangana.
deadlineInfo: Continuous rolling coverage. Operates 365 days a year.

rules.label: Holds a white ration card / food security card

documents.name: Telangana Food Security Card (White Ration Card)
documents.why: Confirms family BPL status and member eligibility.
documents.issuingAuthority: Consumer Affairs, Food & Civil Supplies Dept, Telangana
documents.format: Original or digital Food Security Card copy

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Identity verification and biometric authentication.

process: Step 1: Check your Food Security Card status on epds.telangana.gov.in.
Step 2: Visit any empanelled government or private hospital in Telangana.
Step 3: Approach the 'Aarogya Mithra' desk located at the hospital entrance.
Step 4: Present your White Food Security Card and Aadhaar card.
Step 5: Aarogya Mithra registers your admission on the Aarogyasri trust portal.
Step 6: Network hospital doctor conducts medical evaluation and submits an electronic pre-authorization request.
Step 7: Aarogyasri Trust medical doctors approve the pre-authorization online.
Step 8: Patient receives 100% cashless medical and surgical care, diagnostic tests, and food.
Step 9: At discharge, patient receives 10 days of free medicines and free transportation allowance.

faqs.q: What is the maximum coverage under Telangana Aarogyasri?
faqs.a: In December 2023, the Telangana Government enhanced the Aarogyasri coverage limit to ₹10,00,000 (Ten Lakh Rupees) per family per year.

faqs.q: Who is an Aarogya Mithra?
faqs.a: Aarogya Mithras are dedicated patient facilitators stationed at all empanelled hospitals to help beneficiaries register, undergo evaluation, and receive cashless care.

faqs.q: Does Aarogyasri cover post-discharge medicines?
faqs.a: Yes. The hospital is mandated to provide 10 days of free take-home medicines upon discharge, as well as a transport allowance.

faqs.q: Can I receive treatment in Hyderabad if my card is from a rural district?
faqs.a: Yes. Aarogyasri is valid across all empanelled hospitals in Hyderabad and every district of Telangana.

faqs.q: Are emergency trauma and accident cases covered?
faqs.a: Yes, polytrauma and severe road traffic accident injuries are covered under emergency pre-authorization.

faqs.q: What should I do if a private hospital refuses my card?
faqs.a: Immediately dial the 24/7 Aarogyasri Toll-Free Helpline at 104 or 1800-599-4455.

purpose: Rajiv Aarogyasri Community Health Insurance Scheme, operated by the Aarogyasri Health Care Trust of the Government of Telangana, provides cashless quality treatment to BPL families for catastrophic illnesses requiring hospitalisation, surgery, and multi-speciality therapies.
targetBeneficiary: BPL families in Telangana holding an active Food Security Card (White Ration Card).
financialBenefit: Up to ₹10,00,000 cashless hospitalisation coverage per family per year
benefitFrequency: Annual floating family coverage
impact: Protects low-income households in Telangana from catastrophic healthcare debts, covering expensive cardiac, neurosurgical, and oncology treatments.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: BPL threshold (holders of Telangana Food Security Card).
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Informal laborers, farmers, artisans, and unorganized workers.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: All castes and categories.
detailedEligibility.residenceRequirement: Resident of Telangana with active Food Security Card.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: All family members listed on the White Food Security Card.

mandatoryConditions: Must hold a valid Food Security Card (White Ration Card) issued by the Government of Telangana
Must carry Aadhaar card for biometric authentication
Treatment must be availed at an empanelled government or private Aarogyasri network hospital
conditionalRequirements: Aarogya Mithra verification required at hospital admission.
ineligibility: Government employees and pensioners covered under the Employees and Journalists Health Scheme (EJHS)
Families holding Pink (APL) Ration Cards
Non-residents of Telangana
applicationMode: Direct Walk-in at Empanelled Network Hospital Aarogyasri Counter / MeeSeva
offlineProcess: Walk into any government district hospital, area hospital, or empanelled private super-speciality hospital with your White Ration Card. The Aarogya Mithra at the hospital counter will verify your eligibility on the spot.
commonMistakes: Visiting a hospital that is not empanelled under Aarogyasri: Check empanelled hospital list on aarogyasri.telangana.gov.in before visiting.
Paying cash for diagnostics: All diagnostics, lab tests, and imaging for covered therapies are strictly cashless.
processingTime: Emergency pre-authorization approved within 2 hours; elective cases within 12 hours.
renewalRequired: Auto-renews every year on 1st April.
trackingProcedure: Call 104 or visit aarogyasri.telangana.gov.in to check case sheet and approval status.
correctionProcedure: Add family members to your Food Security Card at the nearest MeeSeva centre.
disbursementMethod: 100% Cashless Hospital Settlement by Aarogyasri Health Care Trust
disbursementDetails: All costs are settled directly by the Aarogyasri Health Care Trust into the network hospital's bank account. Patients do not pay any cash.

name: Telangana ePASS Scholarships
department: Government of Telangana (Welfare Departments)
description: Post-matric scholarships and fee reimbursement for SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority and disabled students in Telangana.
whoCanApply: Telangana students in post-matric courses; income limits are typically ₹2 lakh (urban) / ₹1.5 lakh (rural) for BC/EBC/minority and higher for SC/ST.
benefits: Full reimbursement of college tuition fees (RTF) paid directly to the institution plus monthly maintenance charges / mess fees (MTF) up to ₹1,400 per month (for hostellers) and ₹650 per month (for day scholars) deposited directly into the student's bank account.
deadlineInfo: Announced annually: opens September/October and closes December/January.

rules.label: Family income within the category limit

documents.name: MeeSeva Integrated Caste & Income Certificate
documents.why: Automated verification of caste and income credentials.

documents.name: SSC (Class 10) Hall Ticket & Marksheet
documents.why: Date of birth and basic academic verification.

documents.name: Convenor Allotment Order
documents.why: Confirms admission via TS EAMCET / ICET / POLYCET merit counseling.
documents.issuingAuthority: Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TSCHE)

documents.name: Aadhaar Card & Bank Passbook Copy
documents.why: Identity verification and direct DBT disbursement.

process: Step 1: Secure admission via centralized counseling (TS EAMCET / ICET / etc.).
Step 2: Visit telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in and click 'Postmatric Scholarship Services'.
Step 3: Click 'Fresh Registration' and enter your SSC (Class 10) Hall Ticket Number, Year of Pass, and Date of Birth.
Step 4: Enter your Aadhaar number and MeeSeva Caste & Income Certificate application numbers.
Step 5: Enter College Admission Details, Convenor Hall Ticket Number, and Allotment Order Number.
Step 6: Enter your Bank Account details and upload scanned copies of Allotment Letter, Bank Passbook, and SSC memo.
Step 7: Submit the application and download the printed acknowledgement copy.
Step 8: Submit the physical hardcopy with original verification documents to your College Principal.
Step 9: College verifies biometric attendance and documents on ePASS college login.
Step 10: District Welfare Officer issues sanction, and tuition fees (RTF) and mess charges (MTF) are released via online treasury.

faqs.q: What is RTF and MTF on Telangana ePASS?
faqs.a: RTF stands for Reimbursement of Tuition Fee (paid to the college). MTF stands for Maintenance Fee / Mess Charges (paid directly to the student for living expenses).

faqs.q: Can B.Tech students in private engineering colleges get full fee reimbursement?
faqs.a: Yes. Students securing TS EAMCET ranks below 10,000 receive 100% full fee reimbursement; SC/ST students receive 100% full fee reimbursement regardless of rank.

faqs.q: Is Aadhaar biometric attendance required for scholarship?
faqs.a: Yes. All colleges in Telangana have biometric devices integrated with ePASS, and students must maintain at least 75% biometric attendance.

faqs.q: Can students admitted under Management Quota apply?
faqs.a: No. Only students admitted through Convenor Quota centralized counseling are eligible.

faqs.q: What is the income limit for SC/ST students in Telangana?
faqs.a: The family annual income limit is ₹2,00,000 per annum for SC and ST students.

faqs.q: What should I do if my bank account changed?
faqs.a: Update your bank account at MeeSeva and request your college principal to update the bank details on the ePASS portal before sanction.

purpose: Telangana Electronic Payment and Application System of Scholarships (ePASS), administered by the Welfare Departments of the Government of Telangana, delivers automated post-matric scholarships, full tuition fee reimbursement (RTF), and mess charges (MTF) to SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority students.
targetBeneficiary: Students from SC, ST, BC, EBC, PwD, and Minority communities residing in Telangana pursuing post-matric intermediate, polytechnic, undergraduate, and postgraduate professional courses.
financialBenefit: Full college tuition fee reimbursement (RTF) + Monthly Maintenance Fee (MTF) up to ₹1,400/month
benefitFrequency: Annual fee reimbursement and monthly/quarterly mess allowance
impact: Guarantees free professional education (engineering, medicine, pharmacy, management) for marginalized youth across Telangana.

detailedEligibility.ageRequirement: Maximum 30 years for PG/Professional courses; maximum 34 years for SC/ST.
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: SC/ST: up to ₹2,00,000 (rural) / ₹2,00,000 (urban); BC/EBC/Minority: up to ₹1,50,000 (rural) / ₹2,00,000 (urban).
detailedEligibility.educationRequirement: Class 10 pass with admission into recognized post-matric course in Telangana.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: SC, ST, BC, EBC, Minority, and Physically Challenged.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Covered per student record.

mandatoryConditions: Must be a resident of Telangana with valid MeeSeva integrated caste and income certificate
Must have secured admission through centralized convenor quota (TS EAMCET, ICET, ECET, POLYCET, etc.)
Must maintain minimum 75% attendance in college
Student bank account must be Aadhaar-seeded
conditionalRequirements: Hostel allotment slip from College Warden for hosteller mess charges.
ineligibility: Students admitted through Management / NRI / Spot admission quota
Students pursuing open university or distance correspondence courses
Family annual income exceeding prescribed category limits
Students with attendance below 75%
applicationMode: Online via Telangana ePASS Portal (telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in)
offlineProcess: Submit printed ePASS acknowledgement form along with attested copies of Convenor allotment order, MeeSeva certificates, and bank passbook to your college scholarship counter.
commonMistakes: Entering wrong SSC Hall Ticket number: Causes automated failure to link Class 10 academic records.
Attendance below 75%: Biometric attendance linked to ePASS halts scholarship release if attendance drops below 75%.
processingTime: 60 to 90 days following institutional and district verification.
renewalRequired: Yes, students must submit online renewal applications each subsequent academic year.
trackingProcedure: Click 'Know Your Application Status' on telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in using Application ID and SSC details.
correctionProcedure: College principal can edit student data on the college login before final verification.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT): RTF to College; MTF to Student's Bank Account
disbursementDetails: Tuition fee reimbursement (RTF) is transferred directly into the college account; maintenance fees (MTF) are deposited directly into the student's personal Aadhaar-linked savings account.

name: Jnanabhumi Scholarships (Andhra Pradesh)
department: Government of Andhra Pradesh (Welfare Departments)
description: Andhra Pradesh's portal for post-matric scholarships and fee reimbursement.
whoCanApply: AP students in post-matric courses from eligible categories, with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.
benefits: Jagananna Vidya Deevena: 100% full tuition fee reimbursement credited quarterly directly into the mother's bank account. Jagananna Vasathi Deevena: Food and hostel accommodation allowance of ₹10,000/year (for ITI), ₹15,000/year (for Polytechnic), and ₹20,000/year (for Degree/Engineering/Medicine) credited directly to mother's account.
deadlineInfo: Continuous quarterly academic disbursement cycle aligned with university terms.

documents.name: Rice Card / BPL Household Card of Andhra Pradesh
documents.why: Verifies family economic and welfare eligibility.
documents.issuingAuthority: Civil Supplies Department / Grama Ward Sachivalayam

documents.name: Integrated Caste & Income Certificate
documents.why: Confirms caste category and income within ₹2.5 Lakh ceiling.

documents.name: Convenor Admission Allotment Order
documents.why: Confirms merit admission via AP EAPCET / ICET / POLYCET counseling.

documents.name: Mother's Aadhaar Card & Bank Passbook (NPCI Seeded)
documents.why: Mandatory account for receiving quarterly DBT disbursements.

documents.name: Student Aadhaar Card & SSC Marksheet
documents.why: Student identity and academic verification.

process: Step 1: Secure admission via centralized convenor counseling (AP EAPCET / ICET / etc.).
Step 2: Visit your local Grama Sachivalayam (village) or Ward Sachivalayam (urban) with your mother.
Step 3: Education & Welfare Assistant verifies family details against Navasakam database.
Step 4: Student provides Admission Allotment Order, College details, and Mother's Bank details.
Step 5: Biometric e-KYC authentication of both student and mother is performed at the Sachivalayam.
Step 6: College Principal verifies student admission and course details on Jnanabhumi portal.
Step 7: Social Welfare Department approves quarterly sanction list.
Step 8: Fee reimbursement (Vidya Deevena) and hostel allowance (Vasathi Deevena) are credited directly to mother's bank account via DBT.

faqs.q: Why is the scholarship money credited to the mother's account?
faqs.a: The Andhra Pradesh Government deliberately credits funds to the mother's bank account to empower women and ensure parents hold colleges accountable for educational quality.

faqs.q: What is Jagananna Vasathi Deevena?
faqs.a: Vasathi Deevena covers food and hostel expenses: ₹10,000/year for ITI students, ₹15,000/year for Polytechnic students, and ₹20,000/year for Degree/Engineering/Medical students.

faqs.q: What is the family income limit in Andhra Pradesh?
faqs.a: The family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.

faqs.q: Can students owning four-wheelers apply?
faqs.a: No. Families owning personal four-wheelers are disqualified, though commercial taxis, autos, and tractors used for farming are permitted.

faqs.q: Is attendance checked every month?
faqs.a: Yes. Biometric attendance of 75% or above is strictly mandated for quarterly fee release.

faqs.q: What if the student's mother is not alive?
faqs.a: In the absence of the mother, the funds are deposited into the legal guardian's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

purpose: Jnanabhumi (now implementing Jagananna Vidya Deevena and Jagananna Vasathi Deevena), managed by the Government of Andhra Pradesh, provides full fee reimbursement and living expenses to students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds pursuing higher education.
targetBeneficiary: Students belonging to SC, ST, BC, EBC, Kapu, Minority, and Differently Abled categories pursuing ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, Engineering, Medicine, and Postgraduate courses in Andhra Pradesh.
financialBenefit: 100% full college tuition fees reimbursed + Hostel allowance up to ₹20,000/year
benefitFrequency: Quarterly installments credited directly to mother's bank account
impact: Empowers mothers as financial decision-makers for their children's education, eliminates tuition fee debt, and ensures universal access to higher professional education.

detailedEligibility.genderRequirement: All genders eligible; financial disbursement made directly to mother's account.
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Total family annual income must NOT exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.
detailedEligibility.educationRequirement: Admitted into recognized college course in AP through centralized convenor quota.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: SC, ST, BC, EBC, Kapu, Minority, and Differently Abled.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Total land holding must be less than 10 acres wetland or 25 acres dry land; no family member should own a four-wheeler (except taxi/tractor).

mandatoryConditions: Family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000
Family must not own four-wheeler (except commercial taxi, tractor, or auto-rickshaw)
No family member should be a regular government employee or income tax payer (sanitary workers exempted)
Mother must possess an active, Aadhaar-seeded bank account for receiving DBT
Student must maintain minimum 75% biometric attendance
conditionalRequirements: In the absence of living mother, funds are credited to the legal guardian's bank account.
ineligibility: Students admitted through management / NRI quota
Families owning residential/commercial property exceeding 1,500 sq. ft in municipal areas
Families where any member pays income tax
Students pursuing deemed university or private university courses not affiliated to state universities
applicationMode: Online via Jnanabhumi Portal (jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in) facilitated through Grama/Ward Sachivalayam
offlineProcess: Visit your local Village / Ward Sachivalayam. The Village Education and Welfare Assistant handles document verification, biometric capture, and electronic application submission.
commonMistakes: Mother's bank account not seeded on NPCI: Since payment is sent to the mother, HER account must be actively mapped to NPCI for DBT.
Low biometric attendance: Students with biometric attendance below 75% are disqualified for that quarter's fee credit.
processingTime: Disbursed quarterly directly into bank accounts.
renewalRequired: Auto-renewed each academic year subject to minimum 75% attendance.
trackingProcedure: Log in to jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in using student Aadhaar number or visit your local Sachivalayam.
correctionProcedure: Submit grievance at Grama / Ward Sachivalayam through the 'Spandana' portal.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Mother's Bank Account via AP State CFMS Portal
disbursementDetails: Tuition fee reimbursement and hostel allowances are deposited quarterly into the mother's bank account, who then pays the fee to the college, fostering parental involvement.

name: Digital Gujarat Scholarships
department: Government of Gujarat (Welfare Departments)
description: Gujarat's single portal for SC, ST, OBC and other category scholarships.
whoCanApply: Gujarat students from eligible categories; income limits vary by scheme (commonly ₹2.5 lakh).
benefits: 100% tuition fee reimbursement for SC/ST students in government/aided colleges and up to sanctioned government limits in self-financed colleges plus maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month, book bank allowances, and specialized instrument assistance for technical/medical students.
deadlineInfo: Announced annually: opens August/September and closes October/November.

rules.label: Family income within the scheme limit

documents.name: Gujarat Domicile / School Leaving Certificate
documents.why: Proves residency in Gujarat.

documents.name: Caste Certificate & NCL Certificate (for SEBC)
documents.why: Confirms caste and non-creamy layer status.
documents.issuingAuthority: District Social Welfare Officer / Taluka Development Officer (TDO)

documents.name: Income Certificate issued by TDO / Mamlatdar
documents.why: Verifies family income is within ₹2.5 Lakh limit.

documents.name: College Fee Receipt & Bonafide Certificate
documents.why: Confirms enrollment and fee reimbursement claim.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card & Bank Passbook (NPCI Seeded)
documents.why: Identity verification and direct DBT disbursement.

process: Step 1: Visit digitalgujarat.gov.in and click 'Register'.
Step 2: Enter Mobile Number, Email, and create password. Verify via Mobile OTP.
Step 3: Log in and click 'Scholarship Services' -> 'Post Matric Scholarship'.
Step 4: Enter Personal details, Domicile, Caste Category, and Income details.
Step 5: Enter College details (District, University, College Name, Course, Current Year).
Step 6: Upload Caste Certificate, NCL (if SEBC), Income Certificate, College Fee Receipt, and Marksheet.
Step 7: Enter bank account details and submit online application.
Step 8: Print the completed application form and submit with document photocopies to your college scholarship clerk.
Step 9: College verifies (Level 1), District Social Welfare Officer approves (Level 2).
Step 10: Scholarship funds are credited directly to your bank account via PFMS.

faqs.q: What is the family income limit for SEBC students in Gujarat?
faqs.a: The family annual income limit is ₹2,50,000 per annum for SEBC (OBC) post-matric scholarship.

faqs.q: Can engineering and medical students in self-financed colleges get fee reimbursement?
faqs.a: Yes. SC and ST students receive full or substantial fee reimbursement as per Fee Regulatory Committee (FRC) guidelines in self-financed colleges.

faqs.q: What is the validity of the Gujarat Income Certificate?
faqs.a: Income certificates issued by the Mamlatdar / TDO in Gujarat are valid for 3 financial years from the date of issue.

faqs.q: What is the MYSY scheme in Gujarat?
faqs.a: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY) is Gujarat's merit-cum-means scholarship for General/EWS students scoring above 80 percentile in Class 12.

faqs.q: Can I receive both Digital Gujarat scholarship and MYSY?
faqs.a: No. A student can only avail one government scholarship at a time.

faqs.q: How can I check if my college is registered on Digital Gujarat?
faqs.a: When selecting college details on the portal, choose your district and university; the drop-down will display all approved colleges.

purpose: Digital Gujarat Scholarship Portal, operated by the Government of Gujarat, provides end-to-end paperless post-matric scholarships, freeships, and instrument/hostel assistance to SC, ST, SEBC, and EWS students pursuing higher education across Gujarat.
targetBeneficiary: Students residing in Gujarat belonging to SC, ST, SEBC (OBC), and EWS categories enrolled in post-matric, diploma, degree, and postgraduate courses.
financialBenefit: Full college tuition fee reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month
benefitFrequency: Annual single lump-sum disbursement via DBT
impact: Streamlines educational assistance for over 15 lakh Gujarat students, ensuring direct delivery into bank accounts without college intermediary delays.

detailedEligibility.ageRequirement: No age limit for degree students.
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: SC/ST: up to ₹2,50,000 per year; SEBC (OBC): up to ₹2,50,000 per year.
detailedEligibility.educationRequirement: Class 10 pass and enrolled in recognized post-matric course in Gujarat.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: SC, ST, SEBC, and EWS.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Verified via Digital Gujarat family database.

mandatoryConditions: Must be a permanent resident of Gujarat
Must possess a valid digital Caste Certificate and Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate (for SEBC students)
Family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per year
Student bank account must be actively seeded with Aadhaar on NPCI
conditionalRequirements: Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued in Parishishta-4 format for SEBC applicants.
ineligibility: Non-domicile students of Gujarat
SEBC students without valid Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate
Family annual income exceeding ₹2,50,000
Students in unapproved private courses
applicationMode: Online via Digital Gujarat Portal (digitalgujarat.gov.in)
offlineProcess: Submit the physical copy of the application printout and self-attested documents to your college scholarship desk for digital forwardal.
commonMistakes: Submitting expired NCL certificate: SEBC students must ensure their Non-Creamy Layer certificate is currently valid.
Bank account not linked to Aadhaar: Funds bounce if the bank account is not mapped on the NPCI DBT mapper.
processingTime: 60 to 90 days following college verification.
renewalRequired: Yes, students must apply for renewal every academic year.
trackingProcedure: Log in to digitalgujarat.gov.in and click 'Track Application Status'.
correctionProcedure: College nodal officer can mark defective on the portal for student corrections.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Student's Bank Account via PFMS
disbursementDetails: Tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowances are transferred in single lump-sum directly into the student's Aadhaar-linked savings account.

name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
department: Education Department, Government of Bihar
applyChannel: the 7 Nishchay portal and your District Registration & Counselling Centre (DRCC)
description: Low-interest education loans for Bihar students who have passed Class 12 to pursue higher education.
whoCanApply: Bihar residents who passed Class 12 and are pursuing higher education, within the scheme's age limits.
benefits: Education loan up to ₹4,00,000 without requiring any collateral security, mortgage, or third-party guarantee. Interest rate is deeply subsidized at 4% simple interest for male students, and an ultra-concessional 1% simple interest for female, transgender, and disabled students. Moratorium covers the entire course duration plus 1 additional year before repayment begins.
deadlineInfo: Continuous rolling scheme. Applications accepted year-round.

documents.name: Bihar Domicile Certificate (Niwas Praman Patra)
documents.why: Confirms permanent residence in Bihar.
documents.format: Digitally signed certificate from RTPS portal

documents.name: Class 10 & 12 Marksheets & Passing Certificates
documents.why: Academic qualification proof.

documents.name: College Admission Letter & Approved Fee Structure
documents.why: Proves enrollment and itemized loan requirement (tuition + hostel + books).
documents.format: Official prospectus / fee structure on college letterhead

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Student & Co-Applicant (Parent)
documents.why: Identity verification.

documents.name: Bank Passbook Copy of Student & Parent
documents.why: Account details for loan documentation and living expense disbursement.
documents.format: Passbook copy showing Account Number and IFSC

documents.name: Passport Size Photographs (Student & Parent)
documents.why: Loan file and Smart Card generation.

process: Step 1: Secure admission in an approved degree/diploma course.
Step 2: Visit 7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in and click 'New Applicant Registration'.
Step 3: Enter Name, Mobile Number, and Aadhaar; verify via OTP.
Step 4: Select 'Bihar Student Credit Card (BSCC)' and fill in personal, college, course, and fee details.
Step 5: Submit online application and book an appointment date at your home District Registration and Counseling Centre (DRCC).
Step 6: Visit the DRCC on your scheduled date with your parent and all original documents.
Step 7: DRCC executive scans original documents and provides an Acknowledgement Receipt.
Step 8: Third-party verification agency verifies your college enrollment.
Step 9: Bihar State Education Finance Corporation (BSEFC) sanctions the loan within 30 to 45 days.
Step 10: Sign the loan agreement at DRCC; tuition fees are transferred directly to college, and living allowance to student's account.

faqs.q: What is the interest rate on the Bihar Student Credit Card?
faqs.a: The interest rate is 4% simple interest per annum for male students, and an ultra-concessional 1% simple interest for female, transgender, and disabled students.

faqs.q: When does the loan repayment start?
faqs.a: Repayment starts 1 year after you complete your course, or 6 months after securing employment, whichever occurs first.

faqs.q: Do I need to pledge land or property as collateral?
faqs.a: No! The Bihar State Government acts as the 100% guarantor for the entire loan up to ₹4,00,000. No property mortgage or third-party guarantee is required.

faqs.q: Can I study outside Bihar using this credit card?
faqs.a: Yes. The scheme covers recognized colleges and universities across all states in India.

faqs.q: What happens if a student does not get a job after graduation?
faqs.a: The moratorium can be extended upon submitting an unemployment declaration, and repayment installments are restructured flexibly.

faqs.q: Does the loan cover laptop and hostel expenses?
faqs.a: Yes. The ₹4 Lakh limit includes tuition fees, college hostel fees (or PG rent), books, stationary, and a laptop.

purpose: The Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (BSCCS), launched under the Chief Minister's '7 Nischay' (Seven Resolves) program, provides collateral-free, government-guaranteed education loans up to ₹4,00,000 at deeply subsidized interest rates (and 1% for women/disabled/transgender) to ensure no Bihar student drops out of higher education due to financial hardship.
targetBeneficiary: Students from Bihar who have passed Class 12 and wish to pursue higher education in recognized general, technical, or professional degree/diploma courses across India.
financialBenefit: Collateral-free education loan up to ₹4,00,000 at 4% interest (1% for women & disabled) with moratorium period
benefitFrequency: Disbursed in annual/semester installments directly to college & student
impact: Significantly boosted higher education Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in Bihar, enabling poor students to study engineering, medicine, MBA, BCA, and nursing in leading colleges nationwide.

detailedEligibility.ageRequirement: Up to 25 years at the time of application (up to 30 years for postgraduate courses).
detailedEligibility.genderRequirement: All genders eligible; special 1% interest rate for female and transgender students.
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: NO family income ceiling (open to all economic strata).
detailedEligibility.educationRequirement: Class 12 pass (or Class 10 pass for 3-year polytechnic diploma).
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Student admitted to an approved institution.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories (General, OBC, EBC, SC, ST).
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Parent/guardian joins as co-applicant; no property collateral required.

mandatoryConditions: Must be a permanent resident of Bihar with valid Domicile Certificate
Must have passed Class 12 (Intermediate) from an institution in Bihar (or border areas)
Must have secured admission to an institution accredited by NAAC (minimum 'A' grade or recognized by state council / central bodies)
Loan repayment begins 1 year after course completion or 6 months after getting a job, whichever is earlier
conditionalRequirements: Parent / legal guardian must sign as co-applicant on the loan agreement.
ineligibility: Non-residents of Bihar
Unrecognized institutions or unaccredited non-standard distance degrees
Students already availing bank education loan with central interest subsidy
applicationMode: Online via 7 Nischay Portal (7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in) + In-person verification at District Registration and Counseling Centre (DRCC)
offlineProcess: Physical verification at the District Registration and Counseling Centre (DRCC) in your home district headquarters is mandatory. Carry original certificates, parent co-applicant, and 2 sets of photocopies.
commonMistakes: Choosing an unapproved college: Check whether the college is approved on the BSCC portal; institutions with poor accreditation grades may be excluded.
Missing the DRCC appointment: You must physically visit the DRCC with your parent; failure to attend cancels the digital application.
processingTime: Sanctioned within 30 to 45 working days from DRCC document verification.
renewalRequired: Semestral / annual disbursement release upon submitting pass marksheet of previous semester.
trackingProcedure: Track application progress on 7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in using Registration ID.
correctionProcedure: DRCC executives assist with document re-upload if any discrepancy is flagged.
disbursementMethod: Direct Electronic Transfer: Tuition Fees to College Account; Living Expenses to Student Account
disbursementDetails: Bihar State Education Finance Corporation (BSEFC) transfers college tuition fees directly to the institute's bank account semester-by-semester, and deposits living/hostel allowances into the student's personal savings account.

name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship
department: LIC Golden Jubilee Foundation (Life Insurance Corporation of India)
applyChannel: the LIC website during the announced window
description: Scholarship from LIC's Golden Jubilee Foundation for meritorious students from economically weaker families.
whoCanApply: Students who passed Class 10/12 or diploma with at least 60% marks, pursuing higher studies, with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.
benefits: Comprehensive cash scholarship: ₹40,000 per year for Medicine (MBBS/BDS); ₹30,000 per year for Engineering (B.Tech); ₹20,000 per year for regular Graduation (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com) and Diploma courses; plus a Special Scholarship for Girl Children of ₹15,000 per year for 10+2 studies.
deadlineInfo: Announced annually between November and December.

rules.label: Scored at least 60% in the qualifying exam

documents.name: Class 10 / 12 Marksheet (Minimum 60% Marks)
documents.why: Confirms academic merit qualification.

documents.name: Income Certificate (Family income < ₹2.5 Lakh)
documents.why: Proves compliance with economic ceiling.

documents.name: College Admission Letter & Fee Receipt
documents.why: Confirms regular full-time college enrollment.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card & Bank Passbook Copy (Cancelled Cheque)
documents.why: For direct electronic payment transfer.
documents.format: Bank passbook copy showing Account Number and IFSC

process: Step 1: Check notification on licindia.in under 'Golden Jubilee Foundation'.
Step 2: Click 'Apply for LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship Online'.
Step 3: Fill in Personal Details, Educational Stream (Medical / Engineering / General Graduation / Diploma), and Class 10/12 marks.
Step 4: Enter family income and local LIC Divisional Office jurisdiction.
Step 5: Provide active bank account details (Bank Name, Branch, IFSC, Account Number).
Step 6: Submit the online application. Note down your Application Reference Number.
Step 7: Shortlisted candidates receive an intimation email/call from the nearest LIC Divisional Office.
Step 8: Visit the LIC Divisional Office with original documents for physical verification.
Step 9: LIC Golden Jubilee Foundation issues the sanction letter.
Step 10: Scholarship amount is credited directly to the student's bank account in quarterly installments.

faqs.q: Is LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship open to students of all castes?
faqs.a: Yes! It is open to all Indian citizens regardless of caste, religion, or community, based on merit (60%+) and means (income < ₹2.5L).

faqs.q: What is the Special Scholarship for Girl Child under LIC?
faqs.a: It provides ₹15,000 per year for 2 years to meritorious girl students who have passed Class 10 with 60%+ marks and are pursuing 10+2 higher secondary studies.

faqs.q: How many scholarships does each LIC division grant?
faqs.a: Each LIC Divisional Office selects 20 regular scholars (10 boys and 10 girls) plus 10 girl scholars under the special 10+2 scheme.

faqs.q: Can a student who has an existing LIC policy apply?
faqs.a: Holding an LIC insurance policy is NOT required. The scholarship is open to all deserving students across India.

faqs.q: What is the minimum passing percentage for annual renewal?
faqs.a: Scholars must secure at least 55% marks in their annual college/university examination to continue receiving the scholarship.

faqs.q: Is there any application fee?
faqs.a: No, applying for the LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship is 100% free.

purpose: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship Scheme, established by the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) Golden Jubilee Foundation, provides merit-cum-means financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students to pursue higher education in medicine, engineering, graduation, diploma, and vocational courses.
targetBeneficiary: Meritorious students who passed Class 10 or 12 with at least 60% marks and whose family annual income does not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.
financialBenefit: ₹40,000/year (Medicine), ₹30,000/year (Engineering), ₹20,000/year (Graduation/Diploma), ₹15,000/year (Special Girl Scholarship)
benefitFrequency: Paid in 3 quarterly installments via direct bank transfer
impact: Supports poor, bright students across every LIC divisional territory in India, helping future doctors and engineers complete professional schooling without commercial loans.

detailedEligibility.genderRequirement: All genders eligible; special dedicated scholarship category for girl children.
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Total parental/family annual income must NOT exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.
detailedEligibility.educationRequirement: Minimum 60% marks (or equivalent grade) in Class 10 or Class 12 in the preceding academic year.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS).
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Only one student per family.

mandatoryConditions: Must have scored at least 60% marks in Class 10 or 12 in the current academic year
Total family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per year
Must be pursuing regular full-time higher education in a government-recognized college/university
Student must maintain at least 55% marks in college exams for annual renewal
conditionalRequirements: Medical/Engineering enrollment proof to claim the higher ₹40,000 / ₹30,000 scholarship brackets.
ineligibility: Students scoring below 60% in Class 10/12
Family annual income exceeding ₹2,50,000
Students pursuing correspondence or part-time courses
applicationMode: Online via LIC Official Portal (licindia.in)
offlineProcess: Shortlisted candidates are invited to the nearest LIC Divisional Office to present original marksheets, income certificate, and fee receipts for verification.
commonMistakes: Entering wrong LIC Divisional Office: Choose the LIC division covering your college or permanent residence.
Entering marks below 60%: Automated portal filters reject applications with aggregate marks under 60%.
processingTime: 60 to 75 days from online closing date.
renewalRequired: Yes, renewed annually upon scoring at least 55% in college exams.
trackingProcedure: Contact your local LIC Divisional Office or email co_gjf@licindia.com.
correctionProcedure: Corrections can be made at the Divisional Office during physical document scrutiny.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Student's Bank Account via NEFT/RTGS
disbursementDetails: Disbursed by the LIC Golden Jubilee Foundation in 3 quarterly installments directly into the student's personal savings account.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
department: Reliance Foundation
description: Merit-cum-means scholarships for first-year undergraduate students across streams, with mentoring support.
whoCanApply: Indian students in the first year of a full-time UG degree, with household income below ₹15 lakh (preference for below ₹2.5 lakh), who clear the aptitude test.
benefits: Comprehensive grant of up to ₹2,00,000 over the entire duration of the undergraduate degree course (disbursed in annual tranches of ₹50,000 per year) plus access to leadership workshops, mentorship by global experts, and an alumni network.
estimatedBenefit: Up to ₹2 lakh over the degree
deadlineInfo: Opens annually in August and closes in October.

rules.label: In the first year of a full-time undergraduate degree

documents.name: Class 10 & 12 Marksheets
documents.why: Academic merit verification.

documents.name: College Bonafide Student Certificate
documents.why: Confirms 1st year full-time undergraduate enrollment.
documents.format: Signed bonafide certificate on college letterhead

documents.name: Family Income Proof (ITR / Income Certificate / Salary Slip)
documents.why: Confirms household income meets eligibility criteria.
documents.format: Valid Revenue Certificate or Form 16 / ITR

process: Step 1: Visit scholarships.reliancefoundation.org during the annual application window (August to October).
Step 2: Register with your email and mobile number.
Step 3: Complete the Eligibility Questionnaire and submit personal and college details.
Step 4: Upload Class 10/12 marksheets, Bonafide Student certificate, and Household Income proof.
Step 5: Submit the online application.
Step 6: Take the mandatory 60-minute online Reliance Foundation Aptitude Test from your home computer.
Step 7: Selection committee evaluates combined scores: 12th marks, aptitude test performance, and economic background.
Step 8: Results announced in December/January; 5,000 undergraduate scholars selected across India.
Step 9: Scholars complete bank verification and receive the first ₹50,000 installment via direct bank transfer.

faqs.q: How many undergraduate scholarships are awarded by Reliance Foundation?
faqs.a: 5,000 undergraduate scholarships are awarded across India every year, making it one of India's largest private scholarship initiatives.

faqs.q: Is the scholarship restricted to engineering students?
faqs.a: No! Students enrolled in ANY full-time undergraduate degree program (B.A., B.Com, B.Sc., B.Tech, MBBS, Law, Design, etc.) are eligible.

faqs.q: What is the format of the online aptitude test?
faqs.a: It is a 60-minute online multiple-choice test consisting of 60 questions covering Verbal Ability, Analytical & Logical Reasoning, and Numerical Ability.

faqs.q: What is the income threshold?
faqs.a: Households earning up to ₹15 Lakhs are eligible, though preference and special consideration are given to families earning less than ₹2.5 Lakhs.

faqs.q: Can I receive this scholarship if I also receive another government scholarship?
faqs.a: Yes, Reliance Foundation permits holding other scholarships, provided your college and other funding bodies allow multiple grants.

faqs.q: Is there any interview for undergraduate scholars?
faqs.a: Undergraduate selection is based on Class 12 marks, economic need, and aptitude test scores; there is no personal interview for the undergraduate tier.

purpose: The Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship, instituted by Reliance Foundation, supports meritorious undergraduate students from all socio-economic backgrounds across India to pursue full-time degree programs, nurturing future nation-builders and civic leaders.
targetBeneficiary: Undergraduate students enrolled in the 1st year of any regular undergraduate degree program in India who passed Class 12 with at least 60% marks.
financialBenefit: Up to ₹2,00,000 over the degree course (disbursed at ₹50,000 per year)
benefitFrequency: Annual disbursement across undergraduate degree years
impact: Unlocks world-class learning resources, covers college fees and living costs, and connects students with corporate and technology leadership networks.

detailedEligibility.genderRequirement: All genders eligible; applications from girls and differently-abled students strongly encouraged.
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Household annual income up to ₹15,00,000 per annum (preference given to families earning less than ₹2,50,000 per annum).
detailedEligibility.educationRequirement: Class 12 passed with minimum 60% aggregate marks; currently enrolled in 1st year of full-time undergraduate degree.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Covered per student record.

mandatoryConditions: Must be a full-time 1st year undergraduate student in any recognized degree course in India
Must have secured at least 60% marks in Class 12 board examination
Must complete the mandatory online Reliance Foundation Aptitude Test
Household annual income must not exceed ₹15,00,000 per year
conditionalRequirements: Aptitude test score of 60 minutes duration (consisting of verbal ability, analytical thinking, and numerical ability).
ineligibility: Students pursuing online, distance, or part-time degree courses
Students in 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of college (scholarship is only open to 1st year undergraduate students)
Family annual income exceeding ₹15,00,000
applicationMode: Online via Reliance Foundation Scholarships Portal (scholarships.reliancefoundation.org)
offlineProcess: The entire process from application to aptitude testing and disbursement is 100% digital online.
commonMistakes: Missing the online aptitude test: Applications are strictly evaluated on both Class 12 marks and aptitude test scores; failing to take the test disqualifies the applicant.
Applying in 2nd or 3rd year: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship is strictly open to 1st year undergraduate students.
processingTime: Results announced within 60 to 75 days of application close.
renewalRequired: Yes, renewed annually upon maintaining satisfactory academic grade in college.
trackingProcedure: Log in to scholarships.reliancefoundation.org to check application and selection status.
correctionProcedure: Helpdesk support available via email during the application window.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Student's Bank Account via NEFT
disbursementDetails: Reliance Foundation transfers ₹50,000 annually directly into the student's personal savings account.

whoCanApply: Students in school, diploma, UG or PG courses; each corporate scholarship sets its own income and merit criteria.
benefits: Merit-cum-means corporate scholarships ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹1,00,000 per year depending on the specific corporate CSR scheme applied for (e.g. ACC Vidya Saarathi, JSW Udan, Schindler Igniting Minds, Tata Housing Scholarship).

process: Step 1: Visit vidyasaarathi.co.in and click 'Sign Up'.
Step 2: Complete student registration with your mobile number and email.
Step 3: Complete your Profile (Personal Details, Address, Family Income, Academic History, Bank Details).
Step 4: Upload mandatory documents: Marksheet, Income Proof, Fee Receipt, and Bank Passbook.
Step 5: Click 'Search Schemes'. The portal automatically displays matching CSR scholarship schemes based on your profile.
Step 6: Apply to relevant corporate schemes (e.g. JSW Udan, ACC Vidyasaarathi).
Step 7: Protean team screens applications for document completeness.
Step 8: Corporate CSR committees review and approve selected scholars.
Step 9: Scholarship funds are transferred directly into the student's bank account via NEFT.

faqs.q: What is Vidyasaarathi?
faqs.a: Vidyasaarathi is a digital scholarship platform managed by Protean eGov Technologies (NSDL) that channels corporate social responsibility (CSR) funds directly to deserving students across India.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay any fee to apply on Vidyasaarathi?
faqs.a: No! Applying for scholarships on Vidyasaarathi is completely free. Beware of any agents asking for fees.

faqs.q: Can I apply for more than one scholarship on the portal?
faqs.a: Yes. You can apply to all corporate scholarship schemes for which your profile meets the eligibility criteria.

faqs.q: Which companies offer scholarships on Vidyasaarathi?
faqs.a: Leading corporate donors include ACC Limited, JSW Foundation, Schindler, TransUnion CIBIL, NSDL, Timken, and Care Ratings.

faqs.q: Can diploma and ITI students apply?
faqs.a: Yes, many corporate schemes on Vidyasaarathi are specifically dedicated to ITI, polytechnic diploma, and vocational students.

faqs.q: How will I know if I am selected?
faqs.a: Selected students receive an official email and SMS notification from Vidyasaarathi, and the status updates on their student dashboard.

purpose: Vidyasaarathi is a national digital scholarship gateway managed by Protean eGov Technologies (formerly NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure). It connects underprivileged students with corporate CSR scholarship funds from India's leading corporations (Tata, ACC, JSW, TransUnion, Schindler, NSDL, etc.) through a single transparent portal.
targetBeneficiary: Students across India pursuing ITI, Diploma, Undergraduate, Engineering, Medical, and Postgraduate courses whose family annual income is below ₹5,00,000 per annum.
financialBenefit: Corporate CSR scholarships from ₹10,000 to ₹1,00,000 per year disbursed directly via DBT
benefitFrequency: Annual single lump-sum credit
impact: Unlocks private corporate CSR educational capital for students in rural and industrial belts, funding technical diplomas and higher education.

detailedEligibility.genderRequirement: All genders eligible; several corporate funds earmarked 100% for female students.
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Family annual income typically must NOT exceed ₹3,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 per annum (scheme specific).
detailedEligibility.educationRequirement: Minimum 50% to 60% marks in previous examination.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories (General, SC, ST, OBC).
detailedEligibility.residenceRequirement: Citizen of India (some schemes prioritized for plant-adjacent districts).
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Covered per student record.

mandatoryConditions: Must have secured minimum 50% or 60% marks (as specified by the particular corporate scheme)
Total family annual income must be below the scheme's specified ceiling (usually ₹3 Lakh to ₹5 Lakh)
Must possess an individual active bank account in the student's name
conditionalRequirements: Some corporate funds require domicile in specific operational districts (e.g. near factory sites).
ineligibility: Children of permanent employees of the sponsoring corporate donor company
Students scoring below the minimum percentage threshold
Applications with incomplete or unverified income documents
applicationMode: Online via Vidyasaarathi Portal (vidyasaarathi.co.in)
offlineProcess: The entire application, screening, and disbursement process is managed digitally through the Protean Vidyasaarathi portal.
commonMistakes: Uploading passbook without IFSC/account clarity: Causes rejection during automated bank account validation.
Not checking multiple corporate schemes: A student can apply to multiple matching CSR funds listed on the portal.
processingTime: 45 to 60 days following the closing date of each corporate scheme.
renewalRequired: Varies by corporate scheme; multi-year programs require annual marksheet re-submission.
trackingProcedure: Log in to vidyasaarathi.co.in and check 'Applied Schemes' dashboard.
correctionProcedure: Helpdesk support allows document re-upload if notified of rejection.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Student's Bank Account via NEFT/PFMS
disbursementDetails: Protean eGov Technologies transfers the sanctioned corporate CSR scholarship amount directly into the student's verified savings account.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
applyChannel: Startup India Official Seed Fund Portal online
description: Financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization.
whoCanApply: DPIIT-recognized early stage startups incorporated not more than 2 years ago with an innovative business concept or technology.
benefits: Up to ₹20,00,000 as a grant for validation of Proof of Concept, prototype development, or product trials; and up to ₹50,00,000 of investment for market entry, commercialization, or scaling up through convertible debentures or debt/debt-linked instruments disbursed through eligible incubators.
estimatedBenefit: Up to ₹20 Lakh grant & up to ₹50 Lakh seed funding
deadlineInfo: Continuous national window. Startups can apply anytime through active incubators.

rules.label: DPIIT recognition certificate and incorporation within last 2 years

documents.issuingAuthority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
documents.format: DPIIT Recognition Certificate with DIPP number
documents.validity: Valid for up to 10 years from incorporation
