specificAdvantages: Turnkey government execution: state development corporations directly contract certified drilling agencies and power utilities with zero upfront farmer expenses.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Rural annual income up to ₹2,00,000.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: SC, ST, OBC (Cat-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), or Religious Minorities.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Must own agricultural land: minimum 1.5 acres for individual scheme, or 5+ acres combined for group scheme.

mandatoryConditions: Must be a small or marginal farmer owning between 1.5 and 5 acres of agricultural land (or collective group of farmers owning 5+ acres)
Land must not have an existing operational borewell or canal irrigation source
Valid Caste & Income certificate issued by Revenue Authority (Nadakacheri)
ineligibility: Farmers owning more than 5 acres of irrigated land
Farmlands with existing energized borewells or permanent river/canal irrigation

documents.name: RTC / Pahani (Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops)
documents.why: Proof of agricultural land ownership.

documents.name: Small / Marginal Farmer Certificate
documents.why: Confirms small farmer classification.

documents.name: Caste and Income Certificate (RD Number)
documents.why: Verifies reservation category and income limit.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card & Bank Passbook
documents.why: Identity proof and tracking.

applicationMode: Online via Seva Sindhu Portal & Offline at District Development Corporation Offices
process: Step 1: Obtain updated RTC (Pahani) from Bhoomi portal and Small Farmer Certificate from Tahsildar.
Step 2: Log on to sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in and search for 'Ganga Kalyana Scheme'.
Step 3: Select the appropriate development corporation (Dr. B.R. Ambedkar SC/ST Corp, D. Devaraj Urs BCWD Corp, or KMDC).
Step 4: Enter your RTC survey numbers and upload land documents.
Step 5: District Committee chaired by the local MLA scrutinizes applications and selects eligible beneficiaries.
Step 6: State hydrogeologist conducts water table survey; government contractor drills borewell, installs pump set, and coordinates electrical connection.
offlineProcess: Apply through Grama One citizen centres or visit the District Executive Officer of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Development Corporation or KMDC.
commonMistakes: Submitting outdated RTCs with pending mutation disputes.
Applying for land that already has an energized borewell connection registered under ESCOMs.
openingDate: Annual notification issued between June and August
processingTime: 60 to 90 days from district committee approval to drilling and energization
renewalRequired: One-time permanent scheme
trackingProcedure: Track application status on Seva Sindhu portal using your Ganga Kalyana acknowledgment number.
correctionProcedure: Rectify survey number disputes at the Taluk Tahsildar office.
disbursementMethod: Direct turnkey asset delivery by Government Corporation
disbursementDetails: No cash is handed to the farmer. The state corporation pays hydrogeologists, drilling contractors, pumpset vendors, and electricity boards directly on behalf of the farmer.

faqs.q: What if the drilled borewell fails to yield water?
faqs.a: Under government guidelines, if a drilled well is hydro-geologically dry, the agency is authorized to drill a second attempt subject to committee clearance.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay electricity charges?
faqs.a: No. Agricultural pumpsets up to 10 HP in Karnataka receive 100% free electricity under the state free power subsidy.

name: Raitha Siri Scheme (Karnataka Millet Farming Incentive)
title: Raitha Siri Scheme (Karnataka Millet Farming Incentive)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
targetBeneficiary: Farmers cultivating minor millets (Siri Dhanya: Ragi, Jowar, Foxtail, Little, Kodo, Barnyard, Proso millets)
description: Direct financial incentive of ₹10,000 per hectare (up to ₹20,000 for 2 hectares) transferred straight into the bank accounts of farmers cultivating nutrient-rich millets.
detailedDescription: Raitha Siri is an innovative agrarian initiative to revive nutritious, climate-resilient millet cultivation across Karnataka. Karnataka is recognized as the 'Millet Capital of India'. Under this scheme, farmers growing specified minor millets (Navane/Foxtail, Same/Little, Haraka/Kodo, Korale/Brown top, Baragu/Proso, and Oodhalu/Barnyard millets) receive a direct cash incentive of ₹10,000 per hectare, up to a maximum limit of ₹20,000 for two hectares. The incentive is disbursed directly into the farmer's bank account via the FRUITS portal after satellite/ground crop verification.
purpose: Promotes climate-resilient dryland crops, enhances soil fertility, guarantees crop diversification, and elevates small farmer earnings, directly supporting SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) and SDG 13 (Climate Action).
benefits: Direct financial incentive of ₹10,000 per hectare (up to ₹20,000 for 2 hectares) credited via DBT, in addition to subsidized seeds and micro-nutrients.
financialBenefit: ₹10,000 per hectare (maximum ₹20,000 for 2 hectares) direct cash incentive
benefitFrequency: Seasonal cash incentive per crop cycle (Kharif / Rabi)
impact: Has brought over 1.5 lakh hectares under nutritious organic millet cultivation, boosting farmer net margins in drought-prone districts.
specificAdvantages: Millets require minimal water and fertilizers; the ₹10,000/ha subsidy directly offsets all labor and land preparation expenses.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: No income limit.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Must have land registered under FRUITS (Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System).

mandatoryConditions: Must own or cultivate agricultural land in Karnataka registered with a valid FRUITS ID (FID)
Must cultivate specified minor millets during the notified Kharif or Rabi season
Crop sowing must be verified and recorded in the Karnataka Crop Survey (Bele Samikshe) portal
ineligibility: Farmers growing non-millet commercial cash crops (such as sugarcane, tobacco, or cotton)
Farmlands where millet cultivation is not validated on the official Crop Survey mobile app

documents.name: FRUITS ID (Farmer Registration & Unified Beneficiary Information System)
documents.why: Unified single farmer identity in Karnataka.

documents.name: RTC / Pahani
documents.why: Proof of land cultivation.

documents.name: Crop Survey (Bele Samikshe) Registration Entry
documents.why: Digital photographic verification of standing millet crop.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account
documents.why: For DBT cash incentive transfer.

applicationMode: Online via Karnataka FRUITS Portal & Automatically via Crop Survey (Bele Samikshe)
process: Step 1: Obtain a FRUITS ID (FID) at your local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or on fruits.karnataka.gov.in.
Step 2: Sow notified minor millets (Foxtail, Little, Kodo, Brown top, Barnyard, Proso) during Kharif or Rabi season.
Step 3: Register your crop on the 'Farmer Crop Survey' (Bele Samikshe) mobile app or through the village private surveyor.
Step 4: Agriculture officer verifies the standing crop plot on the portal.
Step 5: The state system automatically calculates the eligible area (₹10,000/ha up to 2 ha).
Step 6: Cash incentive is credited directly into the farmer's bank account via Karnataka State DBT.
offlineProcess: Visit your local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) in your hobli. The Agriculture Officer assists with FRUITS registration and crop entry.
commonMistakes: Missing the Farmer Crop Survey (Bele Samikshe) deadline, which prevents the government system from confirming standing millet crops.
Bank account not mapped in the FRUITS database.
openingDate: Seasonal enrollment aligned with Kharif (June-August) and Rabi (October-December) seasons
processingTime: Cash credited within 30 to 45 days after crop survey verification
renewalRequired: Seasonal registration for each millet cultivation season
trackingProcedure: Check payment status on fruits.karnataka.gov.in by entering your FID number or mobile number.
correctionProcedure: Visit the Raitha Samparka Kendra to resolve crop survey objections before the notified objection deadline.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via FRUITS / Karnataka State DBT
disbursementDetails: Funds transferred electronically via NPCI directly into the bank account linked with the farmer's FRUITS ID.

faqs.q: Is Ragi or Jowar included under Raitha Siri?
faqs.a: Raitha Siri focuses specifically on the six nutritious minor millets (Foxtail, Little, Kodo, Brown top, Proso, Barnyard). Ragi and Jowar have separate Minimum Support Price (MSP) procurement programs.

faqs.q: What is the maximum subsidy a farmer can get?
faqs.a: ₹20,000 for 2 hectares (5 acres) of verified millet crop.

helpline: Kisan Call Centre: 1800-180-1551 / Karnataka Agri Helpline: 080-22212861

name: National Soil Health Card Scheme
title: National Soil Health Card Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture
targetBeneficiary: All agricultural landholders and farming families across India
description: Pan-India agricultural mission issuing biennial customized soil nutrient health report cards to over 23 crore farm plots, optimizing chemical fertilizer use and raising crop productivity.
detailedDescription: The Soil Health Card (SHC) scheme provides every farmer in India with customized crop-wise fertilizer and soil amendment recommendations once every two years. Soil samples are collected using GPS coordinates and tested across 12 crucial parameters: primary nutrients (N, P, K), secondary nutrients (S), micronutrients (Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo), and physical parameters (pH, Electrical Conductivity, Organic Carbon). Farmers save 15-20% on fertilizer costs while improving soil vitality.
purpose: Prevents rampant soil degradation and excessive urea usage, promotes balanced scientific fertilization, and maximizes per-hectare crop yields, supporting SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) and SDG 15 (Life on Land).
benefits: Free comprehensive laboratory testing of 12 soil parameters every 2 years, complete with printed and digital Soil Health Cards with customized dosage guidelines for 6 preferred crops.
financialBenefit: Free scientific soil testing worth ₹1,200 per sample + 15% to 20% average savings on chemical fertilizers
benefitFrequency: Issued once every 2 years (biennial cycle)
impact: Has lowered urea consumption by 8-10%, improved fertilizer use efficiency, and raised farm yields by 10-12% across varied agro-climatic zones.
specificAdvantages: Exact nutrient advisory eliminates wasteful over-spending on chemical fertilizers and restores natural soil microbial health.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: No income limit; open to all landholding farmers.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Must cultivate agricultural land.

mandatoryConditions: Must own or cultivate agricultural land in India
Allow soil sample collection from the designated farm grid by the village agriculture assistant
ineligibility: Non-agricultural, commercial, or residential plots

documents.name: Land Record / RTC / Khasra / Khatauni
documents.why: Identifies survey plot and GPS coordinates.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Farmer identification.

documents.name: Mobile Number
documents.why: For receiving SMS test results and digital card download.

applicationMode: Offline sample collection via Village Agriculture Assistant & Online via soilhealth.dac.gov.in
process: Step 1: Contact your local Village Agriculture Assistant (VAA) or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
Step 2: Agriculture staff collect soil samples from your farm grid (depth 0-15 cm) using GPS coordinates.
Step 3: Sample is tagged with a unique barcode and sent to the district Soil Testing Laboratory (STL).
Step 4: Soil parameters (N, P, K, pH, Zinc, Organic Carbon, etc.) are analyzed.
Step 5: Printed Soil Health Card is delivered to the farmer, with SMS alert containing digital download link.
Step 6: Follow the prescribed dosage recommendations for your upcoming crops.
offlineProcess: Walk into your local Block Agriculture Office, Raitha Samparka Kendra, or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) to request farm soil testing.
commonMistakes: Collecting soil samples immediately after fertilizer application, which severely skews laboratory readings.
Not following the customized micronutrient recommendations printed on the card.
openingDate: Continuous biennial testing cycles throughout the year
processingTime: 15 to 30 days from sample collection to card issuance
renewalRequired: Updated every 2 years
trackingProcedure: Track sample status on soilhealth.dac.gov.in by entering your state, district, and survey/farmer name.
correctionProcedure: Contact the District Soil Testing Officer to rectify farmer name or survey number.
disbursementMethod: Direct delivery of printed laminated Soil Health Card and online PDF download
disbursementDetails: Free physical card distributed at Gram Panchayat meetings or downloadable via the portal.

faqs.q: Is there any testing fee?
faqs.a: No. The Soil Health Card scheme is 100% free for all farmers.

faqs.q: How many parameters are tested?
faqs.a: 12 parameters: Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Sulphur, Zinc, Iron, Copper, Manganese, Boron, pH, EC, and Organic Carbon.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) & NSDC
targetBeneficiary: School/college dropouts, unemployed youth, and informal workers seeking industry certification
description: Flagship skill certification scheme offering 100% free industry-aligned technical and digital skill training, government certification, and placement assistance to over 1.4 crore youth.
detailedDescription: PMKVY 4.0 is the Union Government's flagship vocational training initiative implemented through the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC). It provides free, outcome-driven skill training across 30+ industrial sectors (including AI, robotics, drone technology, green hydrogen, electronics, healthcare, solar technology, logistics, and retail). Beneficiaries receive free course materials, assessment, recognized NSQF certification, accident insurance, and job placement facilitation or entrepreneurship support.
purpose: Bridges the acute industrial skill gap, equips youth with future-ready technical skills, boosts domestic manufacturing employment, and advances SDG 8.
benefits: 100% free training at accredited Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras (PMKK), free NSQF-aligned assessment, Skill India Digital certificate, monetary reward / conveyance allowance, and placement assistance.
financialBenefit: Free certified training worth ₹15,000 to ₹35,000 per candidate + Post-placement financial support
benefitFrequency: One-time certified skill course per candidate
impact: Over 1.37 crore youth trained; has significantly improved entry-level wage employment in organized logistics, IT-enabled services, retail, and manufacturing.
specificAdvantages: Industry-endorsed national certification recognized by leading private employers and government recruitment boards alike.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: No income limit.
detailedEligibility.educationRequirement: Varies by job role (from 5th pass up to Graduate/ITI depending on sector skill qualification pack).
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Unemployed youth, school dropouts, or informal workers seeking RPL (Recognition of Prior Learning).
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: None.

mandatoryConditions: Must possess a valid Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Must have an active bank account for receiving direct post-placement monetary allowance
Minimum 70% attendance during training and passing the standardized third-party assessment
conditionalRequirements: Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) candidates need proof of minimum 1-year prior informal work experience.
ineligibility: Candidates who have already completed the same job role certification under earlier PMKVY versions
Candidates failing the final biometric assessment

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Mandatory biometric e-KYC and attendance tracking via AEBAS.

documents.name: Educational Marksheet / School Leaving Certificate
documents.why: Verifies minimum qualification for the chosen job role.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account Details
documents.why: For conveyance and post-placement incentive DBT.

applicationMode: Online via Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH) & Offline at Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendras (PMKK)
process: Step 1: Download the 'Skill India Digital' app or visit skillindiadigital.gov.in.
Step 2: Register using your mobile number and complete your Aadhaar e-KYC.
Step 3: Browse courses by sector (e.g., Drone Operator, Solar Technician, AI Data Annotator, Healthcare Assistant).
Step 4: Select an accredited training centre (PMKK) in your district and enroll.
Step 5: Attend classroom and practical hands-on training (typically 200 to 400 hours).
Step 6: Undergo third-party practical and theoretical assessment to receive your government certificate and attend campus placement drives.
offlineProcess: Walk into any accredited Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) in your district. Counselors will guide you through course selection and registration.
commonMistakes: Failing to maintain the mandatory 70% biometric attendance, which disqualifies the candidate from the final exam.
Paying fees to unauthorized agents (PMKVY training is 100% free under government mandate).
processingTime: Course duration spans 2 to 4 months
renewalRequired: Certificate valid for lifetime; can upskill in higher NSQF levels after 1 year
trackingProcedure: Track candidate progress and download digital certificate directly on skillindiadigital.gov.in.
correctionProcedure: Update name/mobile details via Skill India Digital candidate profile.
disbursementMethod: Direct training fee settlement to PMKK + DBT conveyance allowance to candidate account
disbursementDetails: Training costs paid directly by NSDC to training partners upon candidate certification and verified placement.

faqs.q: Is PMKVY training free?
faqs.a: Yes. 100% of the training, examination, and certification fees are funded by the Ministry of Skill Development.

faqs.q: Do students get jobs after training?
faqs.a: Yes. Accredited centres organize mandatory job melas and placement drives with employer partners.

name: PM Internship Scheme in Top Companies
title: PM Internship Scheme in Top Companies
department: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA)
targetBeneficiary: Youth aged 21-24 who have completed 10th, 12th, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or non-technical Degrees
description: Landmark national scheme providing 1 crore youth with 12-month paid internships in India's top 500 companies with a monthly stipend of ₹5,000 plus ₹6,000 one-time grant.
detailedDescription: The PM Internship Scheme is a historic public-private initiative announced in the Union Budget to provide 1 crore young Indians with valuable 12-month workplace experience across India's top 500 companies (such as Tata, Reliance, Mahindra, L&T, HDFC, Infosys, ITC, Maruti). Interns receive a monthly stipend of ₹5,000 (₹4,500 contributed by Central Government via DBT + ₹500 from the company's CSR fund) and a one-time grant of ₹6,000 for incidentals, alongside accidental insurance coverage under PMSBY.
purpose: Transforms non-technical and vocational graduates into industry-ready professionals by bridging the gap between classroom theory and real corporate environments, supporting SDG 8.
benefits: Monthly financial stipend of ₹5,000 for 12 months (total ₹60,000) + one-time grant of ₹6,000 + comprehensive work experience in India's top corporate houses + insurance cover.
financialBenefit: ₹5,000 monthly stipend + ₹6,000 one-time grant (Total ₹66,000 direct financial support)
benefitFrequency: Monthly stipend for 12 months
impact: Dramatically enhances graduate employability, gives first-generation college goers direct corporate exposure, and builds a high-calibre junior talent pipeline.
specificAdvantages: Direct placement in premier corporate enterprises without needing influential references; transparent AI-enabled merit-preference portal matching.

detailedEligibility.ageRequirement: 21 to 24 years (as of application cutoff date).
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per year.
detailedEligibility.educationRequirement: Passed Class 10, Class 12, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or non-professional Degree (BA, BSc, BCom, BBA, BCA).
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Not engaged in full-time employment or full-time education.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS).
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: No family member can be an active income tax payer or regular government employee.

mandatoryConditions: Age strictly between 21 and 24 years
Not enrolled in any full-time regular higher education program during the internship
Not currently employed in a formal job with PF/ESI contributions
Family annual income below ₹8 Lakh and no family member paying income tax
Aadhaar-seeded bank account for receiving government DBT stipend
ineligibility: Graduates from elite engineering/medical institutes (IITs, IIMs, IISc, NLU, AIIMS)
Holders of professional degrees like B.Tech, M.Tech, MBBS, BDS, MBA, CA, CS, CMA
Individuals whose parents are permanent government employees or income tax payees

documents.name: Educational Certificates (10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Degree)
documents.why: Verifies eligibility and educational qualification.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Biometric e-KYC verification.

documents.name: Self-Declaration of Family Income and Tax Status
documents.why: Confirms non-taxpayer status under ₹8 Lakh.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account Details
documents.why: For monthly ₹4,500 DBT stipend transfer.

applicationMode: 100% Online via MCA PM Internship Portal (pminternship.mca.gov.in)
process: Step 1: Visit pminternship.mca.gov.in and click 'Register as Candidate'.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar number and verify via OTP.
Step 3: Upload educational credentials and select your career interest areas.
Step 4: Browse internship openings across the top 500 companies filtered by district/state.
Step 5: Select up to 5 internship preferences (role and location).
Step 6: Companies review matched candidate profiles and issue digital offer letters.
Step 7: Accept the offer letter, join the company, and receive your monthly stipend via DBT.
offlineProcess: Online application only. Local Common Service Centres (CSC) assist rural youth with portal registration.
commonMistakes: Applying if you hold a B.Tech or professional degree (the scheme is exclusively reserved for 10th, 12th, ITI, Diploma, and non-technical general graduates).
Providing a bank account that is not mapped to Aadhaar via NPCI.
processingTime: Selection results published within 3 to 4 weeks of cycle closing
renewalRequired: 12-month non-renewable internship
trackingProcedure: Log into pminternship.mca.gov.in using candidate credentials to view application status and offer letters.
correctionProcedure: Edit candidate profile details before the notified application cycle lock date.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT via PFMS) + Direct CSR transfer from Company
disbursementDetails: Central Government credits ₹4,500 directly into the intern's bank account every month; the partner company credits ₹500 directly into the same account.

faqs.q: Is an internship offer guaranteed for all applicants?
faqs.a: No. Matching is automated based on company requirements, merit, and candidate district preferences.

faqs.q: Can interns be hired permanently by the company?
faqs.a: Yes. Top 500 companies frequently offer regular full-time employment to outstanding interns upon completion of the 12-month period.

name: Gruha Jyothi Scheme (Karnataka Free Domestic Electricity)
title: Gruha Jyothi Scheme (Karnataka Free Domestic Electricity)
department: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka
stateCoverage: All 31 districts of Karnataka across BESCOM, MESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, CESC
targetBeneficiary: All domestic households (residents and tenants) in Karnataka consuming up to 200 units of electricity/month
description: Karnataka landmark guarantee scheme providing 100% free electricity up to 200 units per month for all domestic households, slashing monthly utility bills to zero.
detailedDescription: Gruha Jyothi is one of the five flagship guarantees implemented by the Government of Karnataka to shield households from energy inflation and promote basic living dignity. Under this scheme, every residential domestic electricity consumer in Karnataka—whether owner or tenant—whose average consumption is within 200 units per month receives 100% free power. If a household consumes within their personalized entitlement limit (calculated based on average annual usage + 10% buffer up to 200 units), the monthly bill is generated as exactly ₹0.00.
purpose: Guarantees free essential electrical energy to poor, middle-class, and working households, advancing UN Sustainable Development Goal 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy).
benefits: Up to 200 units of domestic electricity per month completely free of charge (Zero Electricity Bill), with the state government reimbursing the ESCOM power utilities directly.
financialBenefit: Zero electricity bill (savings up to ₹1,400 to ₹1,800 per month per household)
benefitFrequency: Monthly zero-bill entitlement
impact: Over 1.65 crore households in Karnataka now receive ₹0 electricity bills, dramatically lowering domestic utility burdens for families.
specificAdvantages: Tenants and renters are fully eligible; automatic monthly zero billing upon linking Aadhaar with the consumer meter Account ID.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: No income limit; universal for all domestic consumers.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.residenceRequirement: Resident of Karnataka (owners or registered tenants).
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: One benefit per household meter Account ID.

mandatoryConditions: Domestic (residential) electricity connection only (commercial meters strictly excluded)
Account ID / Consumer ID of the electricity meter must be linked to Aadhaar on Seva Sindhu
Monthly consumption must remain within the calculated entitlement limit (up to 200 units)
conditionalRequirements: Tenants must upload their rental agreement or submit tenant declaration along with their Aadhaar.
ineligibility: Commercial, industrial, and agricultural electricity installations (domestic LT-1 / LT-2 connections only)
Consumers whose average monthly usage exceeds 200 units
Multiple meters registered under the same Aadhaar

documents.name: Electricity Bill (showing Account ID / Connection ID)
documents.why: Identifies the electricity installation and ESCOM (BESCOM/MESCOM/etc.).
documents.issuingAuthority: Karnataka ESCOMs (BESCOM / HESCOM / MESCOM / GESCOM / CESC)

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Consumer / Tenant
documents.why: For identity verification and de-duplication.

documents.name: Rental Agreement / Voter ID / Lease Deed (for tenants)
documents.why: Proof of residence at rented premises.

applicationMode: Online via Seva Sindhu Portal & Offline at Grama One / Bangalore One / Karnataka One centres
process: Step 1: Keep your latest electricity bill (with 10-digit Account ID) and Aadhaar card ready.
Step 2: Visit sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in and click on 'Gruha Jyothi Scheme'.
Step 3: Select your ESCOM (e.g. BESCOM, HESCOM, MESCOM, GESCOM, CESC).
Step 4: Enter your Account ID; customer name and address auto-populate from the energy database.
Step 5: Select whether you are 'Owner' or 'Tenant', enter your Aadhaar number, and verify via OTP.
Step 6: Submit application and receive immediate digital confirmation. Free billing commences from the subsequent billing cycle.
offlineProcess: Visit your nearest Grama One (village), Karnataka One (town), or Bangalore One centre. The computer operator completes registration in 2 minutes.
commonMistakes: Entering a commercial meter number instead of a domestic residential connection.
Consuming significantly over 200 units, which nullifies the free subsidy and results in full bill payment.
processingTime: Immediate registration; zero-billing reflects from the next calendar billing cycle
renewalRequired: No annual renewal; continues automatically
trackingProcedure: Check status on Seva Sindhu or check your monthly electricity bill for 'Subsidy under Gruha Jyothi: Net Payable ₹0.00'.
correctionProcedure: If vacating a rented house, unlink your Aadhaar from the old Account ID on Seva Sindhu before moving to a new residence.
disbursementMethod: Direct adjustment on monthly electricity bill (Net Payable = ₹0.00)
disbursementDetails: Meter reader generates bill on spot machine showing total consumption, government subsidy credited, and net payable amount as ₹0.00.

faqs.q: Can tenants living in rented houses apply?
faqs.a: Yes. Tenants are fully eligible by linking their Aadhaar and providing their rental address/agreement.

faqs.q: What happens if I use 205 units in a month?
faqs.a: If total consumption exceeds 200 units, the consumer has to pay the entire bill for that particular month.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
title: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
stateCoverage: All rural households across all 28 States & 8 Union Territories
targetBeneficiary: All rural households, schools, anganwadis, and community centres across India
description: Transformative national water infrastructure program providing individual functional household tap connections (FHTC) with 55 litres per capita per day potable water to over 15 crore rural homes.
detailedDescription: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal) is the world's most extensive rural drinking water initiative. It aims to provide every rural household in India with a Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) delivering 55 litres of potable, tested drinking water per person per day on a long-term, reliable basis. Implemented through Village Water and Sanitation Committees (Pani Samitis), the scheme eliminates water-fetching drudgery for rural women and eliminates waterborne epidemics through sensor-based IoT water quality monitoring.
purpose: Eliminates physical drudgery for rural women walking miles for water, eradicates fluorosis and waterborne diseases, and secures clean drinking water equity, supporting SDG 6.
benefits: Free individual functional piped water tap installed at the household courtyard, providing 55 litres/person/day of safe, treated, laboratory-tested drinking water.
financialBenefit: 100% Free household tap connection infrastructure worth ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per household
benefitFrequency: Daily continuous/scheduled piped water supply
impact: Has increased rural tap water coverage from 17% in 2019 to over 78% in 2024, saving millions of hours of daily female labor and dramatically reducing child diarrhoea.
specificAdvantages: Zero installation charges for poor households; water quality monitored via field test kits by local women's self-help groups.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: No income limit; universal saturation across every rural home.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.residenceRequirement: Resident of any rural village in India.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Must reside in a village where piped water network is being commissioned.

mandatoryConditions: Household must be situated within the notified rural revenue village boundary
Cooperation with Gram Panchayat / Village Water & Sanitation Committee (VWSC)
ineligibility: Commercial establishments and factories

documents.name: Gram Panchayat Residence / House Assessment Entry
documents.why: Confirms household residence within village.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Head of Household
documents.why: For registration on JJM IMIS portal.

applicationMode: Community Saturation via Gram Panchayat / Pani Samiti
process: Step 1: The Gram Panchayat and Village Water & Sanitation Committee (VWSC) prepare the Village Action Plan.
Step 2: State Public Health Engineering Department (PHED) / Rural Water Supply lays main pipelines and distribution network.
Step 3: Surveyors visit every household to register tap connections on the JJM mobile app.
Step 4: Certified plumbing contractors install the ferrule connection, pipe, and brass tap at the household entrance/kitchen.
Step 5: Village Pani Samiti tests water quality using Field Test Kits (FTKs).
Step 6: Village declares 'Har Ghar Jal' certified status through Gram Sabha resolution.
offlineProcess: Contact your local Gram Panchayat President (Sarpanch) or Village Water and Sanitation Committee member. No individual paperwork required; works on village-wide saturation.
commonMistakes: Installing booster pumps directly on the pipeline (strictly prohibited as it depresses water pressure for neighboring homes).
processingTime: Tap installed during village network execution
renewalRequired: None; nominal community maintenance fee decided by Gram Sabha
trackingProcedure: Track village and household coverage live on the JJM Public Dashboard at ejalshakti.gov.in/jjmreport.
correctionProcedure: Report leaks or low pressure to the Gram Panchayat water lineman or call state PHED helpline.
disbursementMethod: Direct physical tap infrastructure installation at household doorstep
disbursementDetails: Turnkey delivery by Rural Water Supply engineering departments.

faqs.q: Is the tap connection free?
faqs.a: Yes. Infrastructure installation up to the household boundary is 100% funded by Central and State Governments.

faqs.q: How is water quality tested?
faqs.a: Every water source is tested twice a year for chemical and bacteriological parameters at district labs, and 5 trained women in every village test taps using Field Test Kits.

name: Sandhya Suraksha Yojana (Karnataka Senior Citizen Pension)
title: Sandhya Suraksha Yojana (Karnataka Senior Citizen Pension)
department: Directorate of Social Security and Pensions, Revenue Department, Government of Karnataka
targetBeneficiary: Elderly senior citizens aged 65 and above from economically weaker families in Karnataka
description: Monthly social security pension of ₹1,200 deposited directly into the bank accounts of indigent senior citizens aged 65 and above in Karnataka, alongside healthcare and bus pass concessions.
detailedDescription: Sandhya Suraksha Yojana is Karnataka's premier social safety net for elderly citizens who lack institutional support, family financial backing, or pension provisions. Every resident senior citizen aged 65 or above whose combined family annual income does not exceed ₹20,000 receives a monthly financial pension of ₹1,200 deposited via Direct Benefit Transfer. Beneficiaries also receive subsidized medical checkups at state hospitals and concessional KSRTC/BMTC bus passes.
purpose: Prevents elderly destitution, guarantees financial dignity and medical autonomy in old age, and shields senior citizens from poverty, supporting SDG 1 and SDG 3.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,200 deposited directly into savings bank / post office account, concessional healthcare, and subsidized bus travel pass.
financialBenefit: ₹1,200 per month (₹14,400 annually) direct cash pension
benefitFrequency: Monthly Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
impact: Provides subsistence income to over 38 lakh impoverished senior citizens in Karnataka, enabling them to buy medicines and daily groceries without dependence.
specificAdvantages: Direct lifetime pension without requiring prior employment contributions; doorstep cash delivery via postal bank for bedridden elderly.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Combined annual income of applicant and spouse must not exceed ₹20,000.
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Retired, informal workers, agricultural laborers, destitute elderly.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.residenceRequirement: Resident of Karnataka for at least 3 years.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Combined bank deposits of applicant and spouse must not exceed ₹10,000.

mandatoryConditions: Must be a resident of Karnataka aged 65 or above
Total annual income of applicant and spouse not exceeding ₹20,000
Must not already be receiving another government old-age pension (e.g. IGNOAPS or private corporate pension)
ineligibility: Elderly individuals already drawing government servant pensions or high-income pensions
Individuals whose children are government servants paying income tax

documents.name: Age Proof (Voter ID / Birth Certificate / School Certificate / Medical Officer Age Certificate)
documents.why: Verifies minimum age of 65 years.

documents.name: Income and Residence Certificate
documents.why: Verifies income below ₹20,000 and 3 years Karnataka residence.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Identity and biometric verification.

documents.name: Bank / Post Office Savings Passbook
documents.why: For monthly DBT pension deposit.

applicationMode: Online via Seva Sindhu / Nadakacheri & Offline at Village Grama One / Atalji Janasnehi Kendra
process: Step 1: Obtain an Income & Domicile certificate from your local Nadakacheri (Atalji Janasnehi Kendra).
Step 2: Visit sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in or your village Grama One centre.
Step 3: Fill out the Sandhya Suraksha application form with age proof, RD number, and bank account details.
Step 4: Village Administrative Officer (VAO) conducts field verification of applicant's living conditions.
Step 5: Taluk Revenue Inspector and Tahsildar sanction the pension order.
Step 6: ₹1,200 pension is credited monthly into the senior citizen's bank account.
offlineProcess: Walk into your local Atalji Janasnehi Kendra (Nadakacheri) or Taluk Tahsildar office. The staff will verify age documents and generate the pension application.
commonMistakes: Age proof showing below 65 years (must be 65+ on the date of application).
Bank account not active or dormant due to non-usage.
processingTime: 21 to 30 business days under Karnataka Sakala Guarantee
renewalRequired: Annual digital life certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) or biometric verification at Grama One / Post Office
trackingProcedure: Track application status on nadakacheri.karnataka.gov.in using your application RD number.
correctionProcedure: Visit the Taluk Tahsildar office (Social Security Pension section) to rectify bank account or address.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via Karnataka Treasury to Bank / Post Office Account
disbursementDetails: Pension credited on the 1st week of every month. Bedridden seniors can receive home cash delivery via India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) micro-ATMs.

faqs.q: Can both husband and wife receive Sandhya Suraksha pension?
faqs.a: Yes, if both individuals are aged 65 or older and satisfy the combined income benchmark, both can receive individual pensions.

faqs.q: What if an elderly person does not have a birth certificate?
faqs.a: An Age Certificate issued by the Taluk Government Medical Officer / District Hospital Surgeon is accepted as valid age proof.

name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)
title: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
targetBeneficiary: Persons with benchmark disabilities (40% or more) from low-income families
description: 100% free modern assistive aids—motorized tricycles, smart canes, digital hearing aids, battery wheelchairs, artificial limbs, and daisy players—distributed nationwide via ALIMCO.
detailedDescription: The ADIP Scheme provides sophisticated, modern, durable, and standard assistive aids and appliances to persons with disabilities (Divyangjan) to foster their physical independence, education, and economic integration. Implemented through the Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India (ALIMCO) and district disability camps, it provides 100% free aids for individuals earning up to ₹20,000/month (and 50% subsidy for income between ₹20,000 and ₹30,000/month). Equipment includes motorized tricycles, braille smart kits, smart canes, cochlear implants (up to ₹6 Lakh for deaf children under 5), and custom prosthetic limbs.
purpose: Restores mobility, communication, and economic self-sufficiency to persons with disabilities, eliminating physical barriers and advancing SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities).
benefits: 100% free assistive devices: motorized tricycles, wheelchairs, smart canes, digital behind-the-ear hearing aids, artificial limbs, prosthetics/orthotics, and cochlear implants up to ₹6 Lakh.
financialBenefit: Assistive equipment worth ₹5,000 to ₹6,00,000 (Cochlear Implants) provided 100% free
benefitFrequency: Replacements provided every 3 years (or 1 year for growing children)
impact: Has empowered millions of Divyangjan to pursue college education, travel independently, and work in competitive employment.
specificAdvantages: High-quality BIS-certified equipment manufactured by ALIMCO; regular mega distribution camps in every district.

detailedEligibility.ageRequirement: All ages (Cochlear implants: children under 5 years; motorized tricycles: 16+ years).
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Full 100% free: monthly family income up to ₹20,000; 50% subsidy: income ₹20,001 to ₹30,000/month.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Must have benchmark disability of 40% or more.

mandatoryConditions: Must possess a valid Disability Certificate / Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card showing 40% or greater disability
Family monthly income not exceeding ₹30,000
Must not have received the same assistive device free from the government within the past 3 years (except for growing children under 12)
ineligibility: Individuals with disability certified below 40%
Individuals earning over ₹30,000 per month

documents.name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card / Disability Certificate
documents.why: Mandatory clinical proof of 40%+ disability.
documents.format: UDID Card or Medical Board Certificate

documents.name: Income Certificate / BPL Ration Card
documents.why: Determines 100% free grant eligibility.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Identity verification.

documents.name: Passport Size Photographs (Full Length Photo showing disability)
documents.why: For device customization.

applicationMode: Online via adip.disabilityaffairs.gov.in & Offline at District Disability Assessment Camps / ALIMCO
process: Step 1: Check the schedule for upcoming ALIMCO assessment camps in your district or visit the District Disability Rehabilitation Centre (DDRC).
Step 2: Attend the camp with your UDID Card, Aadhaar, and income proof.
Step 3: ALIMCO biomedical engineers and prosthetists evaluate your physical measurement (limb casting or audiogram).
Step 4: Your application is approved on the ADIP portal.
Step 5: Attend the Mega Distribution Camp in your district to receive your free motorized tricycle, wheelchair, hearing aid, or custom artificial limb.
Step 6: Engineers adjust fitting and provide user operational training on the spot.
offlineProcess: Visit your District Disability Rehabilitation Centre (DDRC) or the District Social Welfare / Disabled Welfare Office located in the district headquarters.
commonMistakes: Applying without a valid UDID Card (temporary handwritten hospital chits without board signatures are rejected).
openingDate: Continuous year-round camps and portal applications
processingTime: Assessment to device distribution typically takes 30 to 60 days
renewalRequired: Device replacement eligible every 3 years
trackingProcedure: Track beneficiary status on adip.disabilityaffairs.gov.in using UDID number or Aadhaar.
correctionProcedure: Contact the District Disabled Welfare Officer (DDWO).
disbursementMethod: Direct physical delivery of custom-fitted assistive equipment
disbursementDetails: Equipment distributed at district public distribution camps with on-site fitting, battery chargers, and warranty cards.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for a motorized tricycle?
faqs.a: Severely orthopaedically impaired persons aged 16 and above with both lower limbs affected (disability 80% or more) who have good upper-limb strength.

faqs.q: Is cochlear implant surgery completely free under ADIP?
faqs.a: Yes. For profoundly deaf children under 5 years, the entire surgery and implant cost up to ₹6,00,000 is 100% covered.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
title: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) & SIDBI
targetBeneficiary: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) seeking collateral-free business loans
description: Government-backed collateral-free bank loans up to ₹5 Crore for manufacturing and service MSMEs, with 75% to 85% credit guarantee coverage provided to lending banks.
detailedDescription: CGTMSE, established jointly by the Ministry of MSME and SIDBI, eliminates the biggest hurdle faced by small businesses: bank demands for third-party collateral security and real estate property mortgages. Under CGTMSE, scheduled commercial banks, regional rural banks, and NBFCs provide term loans and working capital credit facilities up to ₹5,00,00,000 (₹5 Crore) to eligible micro and small enterprises entirely without collateral security. In case of business default, the Trust guarantees up to 85% of the loan amount back to the lending bank.
purpose: Drives grassroots industrialization, unlocks formal credit for first-generation entrepreneurs without ancestral property, and expands manufacturing output, supporting SDG 8 and SDG 9.
benefits: Collateral-free and third-party-guarantee-free bank loans up to ₹5 Crore (₹500 Lakh) with 75% to 85% credit risk guarantee, reduced interest rates, and relaxed margin norms.
financialBenefit: Collateral-free bank loan up to ₹5,00,00,000 with 75% to 85% sovereign credit guarantee
benefitFrequency: Term loan / Revolving working capital credit facility
impact: Has enabled over 80 lakh micro-enterprises to access formal bank credit, creating millions of manufacturing and technical jobs across India.
specificAdvantages: Entrepreneurs do not need to mortgage residential property or land; women-owned and SC/ST enterprises receive up to 85% guarantee coverage.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: No personal income limit; evaluated based on project viability and cash flow.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories (higher 85% guarantee for Women, SC/ST, Aspirational Districts, and North East).
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Enterprise must be registered under Udyam.

mandatoryConditions: Must be a registered Micro or Small Enterprise holding a valid Udyam Registration Certificate
Enterprise must be engaged in manufacturing or service activities (retail trade covered up to ₹2 Crore)
Loan facility must be sanctioned by an empanelled Member Lending Institution (commercial bank, RRB, SIDBI, or NBFC)
Clear CIBIL / credit bureau record with no wilful bank defaults
ineligibility: Educational institutions, training institutes, self-help groups (SHGs), and agricultural credit
Medium and Large scale enterprises

documents.name: Udyam Registration Certificate
documents.why: Statutory proof of Micro/Small Enterprise status.

documents.name: Detailed Project Report (DPR) & Financial Statements
documents.why: Demonstrates business viability, projected cash flows, and debt service coverage ratio (DSCR).

documents.name: KYC Documents of Promoters / Partners / Directors (Aadhaar, PAN)
documents.why: Identity and tax proof.

documents.name: GST Registration Certificate & Bank Statements
documents.why: Verifies business turnover and banking discipline.

applicationMode: Online via JanSamarth Portal (jansamarth.in) & at all Scheduled Commercial Banks
process: Step 1: Obtain your free Udyam Registration Certificate on udyamregistration.gov.in.
Step 2: Prepare your Detailed Project Report (DPR) including machinery quotes and financial projections.
Step 3: Apply on the government's unified credit portal jansamarth.in or directly approach your nearest public/private bank branch.
Step 4: Request loan coverage under the CGTMSE Collateral-Free Credit Guarantee Scheme.
Step 5: Bank evaluates project viability and sanctions the credit facility without demanding property mortgage.
Step 6: Bank registers the loan directly on the CGTMSE portal (cgtmse.in) to activate guarantee coverage.
offlineProcess: Walk into any branch of State Bank of India, Canara Bank, Bank of Baroda, PNB, or your regional rural bank. Meet the Branch Manager or MSME Relationship Manager.
commonMistakes: Approaching the bank without a formal Udyam certificate and realistic cash-flow projections.
Allowing credit bureau / CIBIL score to fall below acceptable banking thresholds before applying.
openingDate: Open year-round across all bank branches
processingTime: 15 to 30 business days following complete documentation
renewalRequired: Annual guarantee fee payable to the Trust through the lending bank
trackingProcedure: Track application status on jansamarth.in or directly with your branch credit officer.
correctionProcedure: Revise DPR assumptions as requested by the bank credit appraisal team.
disbursementMethod: Direct credit of loan amount into enterprise current account / vendor payments
disbursementDetails: Term loan disbursed directly to machinery and plant suppliers; working capital line opened in the enterprise current account.

faqs.q: Can a new startup get a CGTMSE loan?
faqs.a: Yes. Both greenfield (new) startups and existing enterprises undergoing expansion are fully eligible.

faqs.q: What is the guarantee fee?
faqs.a: A nominal annual guarantee fee ranging between 0.37% and 1.35% depending on loan slab and category, paid through the lending bank.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
title: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
department: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
stateCoverage: All 28 States & 8 Union Territories under One District One Product (ODOP)
targetBeneficiary: Individual micro food processing entrepreneurs, FPOs, Self Help Groups (SHGs), and producer cooperatives
description: Credit-linked 35% capital subsidy up to ₹10,00,000 for setting up or modernizing micro food processing units (flour mills, spice processing, bakery, dairy, oil extraction, fruit pulp).
detailedDescription: The PMFME Scheme, launched under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan with a ₹10,000 Crore outlay, provides financial, technical, and business support to micro food processing entrepreneurs. Built around the 'One District One Product' (ODOP) framework, it provides a 35% credit-linked capital subsidy (up to ₹10 Lakh per enterprise), seed capital of ₹40,000 per SHG member for working capital, and 50% grants for common infrastructure and branding/marketing. Free handholding is provided by District Resource Persons (DRPs).
purpose: Formalizes unorganized micro-food enterprises, cuts post-harvest food wastage, enhances food safety compliance (FSSAI), and builds regional agro-processing brands, supporting SDG 2, SDG 8, and SDG 12.
benefits: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy on bank loan (maximum ₹10,00,000), seed capital of ₹40,000 for SHG food workers, 50% branding/marketing subsidy, and free FSSAI food quality training.
financialBenefit: 35% capital subsidy up to ₹10,00,000 on bank loan + ₹40,000 seed capital per SHG member
benefitFrequency: One-time capital subsidy per food enterprise
impact: Over 85,000 micro-food enterprises modernized; has significantly multiplied rural agricultural value addition and export potential.
specificAdvantages: Dedicated District Resource Persons (DRP) appointed in every district provide free doorstep DPR preparation and loan filing assistance.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: No income limit.
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Micro food processing entrepreneur, SHG member, or farmer producer.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Only one person from a family is eligible for individual capital subsidy.

mandatoryConditions: Enterprise must be engaged in food processing (processing of grains, fruits, vegetables, spices, dairy, meat, bakery, beverages)
Applicant must contribute minimum 10% of project cost as owner equity
Remaining 90% financed via bank loan, on which the 35% capital subsidy is adjusted
Alignment with the district's notified 'One District One Product' (ODOP) or other viable food product
ineligibility: Trading-only enterprises (buying and selling raw agricultural produce without processing)
Large and medium food industries

documents.name: Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
documents.why: Identity and tax verification.

documents.name: Detailed Project Report (DPR) & Machinery Quotation
documents.why: Specifies food processing machinery, capacity, and civil work.

documents.name: Land / Premises Ownership or Rent Agreement
documents.why: Proof of operating premises.

documents.name: FSSAI Food License / Registration (or undertaking to apply)
documents.why: Statutory food hygiene and safety compliance.

documents.name: Bank Statements & Udyam Certificate
documents.why: Financial appraisal.

applicationMode: Online via National PMFME Portal (pmfme.mofpi.gov.in)
process: Step 1: Visit pmfme.mofpi.gov.in and register under 'Applicant Registration'.
Step 2: Choose your district and identify the local District Resource Person (DRP).
Step 3: DRP assists you in preparing your Detailed Project Report (DPR) and gathering machinery quotes free of charge.
Step 4: Upload your documents and submit application on the PMFME portal.
Step 5: District Level Committee (DLC) scrutinizes the proposal and forwards it to your preferred bank.
Step 6: Bank sanctions loan; Ministry releases the 35% subsidy directly into the bank's subsidy reserve fund account.
offlineProcess: Meet the District Resource Person (DRP) at the District Industries Centre (DIC) or District Horticulture/Agriculture Office.
commonMistakes: Purchasing second-hand machinery (subsidy is only permissible on new food processing plant and machinery).
Neglecting FSSAI licensing requirements.
processingTime: 30 to 45 days from DLC clearance to bank sanction
renewalRequired: One-time capital subsidy
trackingProcedure: Track application live on pmfme.mofpi.gov.in using your login credentials.
correctionProcedure: Your assigned District Resource Person can unlock and update application files.
disbursementMethod: Direct credit to Bank's Subsidy Reserve Fund (Back-ended Subsidy)
disbursementDetails: Subsidy is credited into a Subsidy Reserve Fund account in the lending bank. After 3 years of satisfactory unit operation, it is credited to extinguish the loan principal without interest.

faqs.q: Is the DRP support free?
faqs.a: Yes. The Ministry pays the District Resource Person; applicants do not pay any fee for DPR preparation.

faqs.q: Can home-based pickle and spice makers apply?
faqs.a: Yes. Micro home-scale entrepreneurs can apply to upgrade packaging, grinding machinery, and get FSSAI certified.

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Maharashtra)
title: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Maharashtra)
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
targetBeneficiary: Destitute persons, blind, disabled, orphans, divorced women, and persons suffering from major illness in Maharashtra
description: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 deposited via DBT to destitute, disabled, widowed, and abandoned persons in Maharashtra with family income up to ₹50,000.
detailedDescription: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana provides monthly financial maintenance to destitute individuals, physically and mentally disabled persons, widows, divorced women, and patients suffering from cancer, tuberculosis, or paralysis who have no source of livelihood. The pension amount was enhanced to ₹1,500 per month for single beneficiaries and ₹2,400 per month for families with two or more beneficiaries, disbursed via DBT through the Aaple Sarkar portal.
purpose: Guarantees a permanent social safety net for destitute and vulnerable citizens in Maharashtra without familial support, supporting SDG 1 and SDG 10.
benefits: Monthly cash pension of ₹1,500 (single beneficiary) or ₹2,400 (families with 2+ beneficiaries) credited directly to bank account via DBT.
financialBenefit: ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 annually) direct cash pension
benefitFrequency: Monthly Direct Benefit Transfer
impact: Provides basic sustenance, food, and medicine purchasing power to over 28 lakh destitute individuals in Maharashtra.
specificAdvantages: Covers divorced, abandoned, and severely ill persons who are often excluded from standard national pensions.

detailedEligibility.ageRequirement: 18 to 65 years (disabled, widows, divorced); 65+ years (destitute elderly).
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Annual family income must not exceed ₹50,000.
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Destitute, unemployed, or incapable of manual labor.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.residenceRequirement: Resident of Maharashtra for at least 15 years.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: No adult earning family members capable of providing support.

mandatoryConditions: Must be a resident of Maharashtra for at least 15 continuous years (Domicile Certificate)
Annual family income below ₹50,000 certified by the Tahsildar
Medical Certificate from Civil Surgeon if applying under disability or severe illness category
ineligibility: Individuals whose children are government servants or regular income earners
Individuals already receiving another state pension exceeding ₹1,500/month

documents.name: Maharashtra Domicile / 15-Year Residence Certificate
documents.why: Proves 15 years continuous residence in Maharashtra.

documents.name: Income Certificate (Below ₹50,000)
documents.why: Confirms income eligibility.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card & Bank Passbook
documents.why: Identity proof and DBT credit.

documents.name: Civil Surgeon Medical / Disability Certificate (if applicable)
documents.why: Proves 40%+ disability or critical illness.

applicationMode: Online via Aaple Sarkar (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in) & Offline at Tahsildar Office / Setu Kendra
process: Step 1: Obtain 15-year Domicile and Income Certificate from your local Setu Kendra or on aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in.
Step 2: Submit application under 'Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Scheme' with bank account details.
Step 3: Talathi and Circle Officer conduct on-ground inquiry.
Step 4: Taluka Committee chaired by the local MLA/Tahsildar approves the pension proposal.
Step 5: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 is credited via DBT to the beneficiary's bank account.
offlineProcess: Submit application form at the Sanjay Gandhi Yojana desk in the Taluka Tahsildar office or your nearest Setu Suvidha Kendra.
commonMistakes: Submitting an income certificate exceeding ₹50,000 per annum.
Failing to submit annual digital life certificate (Jeevan Pramaan).
processingTime: 30 to 45 business days under Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act
renewalRequired: Annual life certificate verification required
trackingProcedure: Track application status on aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in using application ID.
correctionProcedure: Visit Tahsildar office to correct bank account or IFSC code.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Bank Account via Maharashtra Treasury
disbursementDetails: Pension credited on the 1st week of every month directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

faqs.q: Are divorced or abandoned women eligible?
faqs.a: Yes. Divorced or legally separated women and women deserted by husbands without maintenance are explicitly eligible.

name: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
title: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
targetBeneficiary: Daughters of poor families (General, OBC, SC, ST, Minorities) in Uttar Pradesh
description: Financial assistance of ₹51,000 per wedding (₹35,000 DBT to bride's bank account + ₹10,000 wedding gift items + ₹6,000 event cost) under mass marriage celebrations in UP.
detailedDescription: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana eliminates the crushing debt trap of daughter weddings for impoverished families in Uttar Pradesh. The state government organizes grand community wedding ceremonies with all religious customs respected. Each eligible couple receives ₹51,000 in total assistance: ₹35,000 is transferred directly via DBT into the bride's personal savings bank account, ₹10,000 is given as durable wedding gift articles (silver jewellery, utensils, saree, clothes, mobile phone), and ₹6,000 covers wedding pandal, feast, and celebration expenses.
purpose: Eradicates dowry exploitation, curtails lavish wedding borrowing by poor families, and supports girl dignity, advancing SDG 5.
benefits: Total benefit of ₹51,000 per couple: ₹35,000 direct bank transfer to the bride + ₹10,000 household gift hamper + ₹6,000 celebration cost.
financialBenefit: ₹35,000 cash DBT to bride + ₹10,000 durable gift items (Total ₹51,000 wedding assistance)
benefitFrequency: One-time grant per daughter
impact: Over 4 lakh underprivileged girls have married with state dignity, saving families from predatory rural moneylenders.
specificAdvantages: Open to all religions and castes; weddings performed following Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, or Buddhist customs at government expense.

detailedEligibility.ageRequirement: Bride must be 18+ years; Groom must be 21+ years.
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Annual family income up to ₹2,00,000 (urban and rural).
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all (SC, ST, OBC, General, Minorities).
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Wedding must be performed at an official mass marriage event.

mandatoryConditions: Bride must be at least 18 years old and Groom must be at least 21 years old on the wedding date
Family income within ₹2,00,000 per annum certified by competent revenue authority
Marriage must be solemnized in the official mass marriage event organized by the District Magistrate / Municipal Corporation
ineligibility: Underage marriages (bride below 18 or groom below 21)
Families whose annual income exceeds ₹2,00,000

documents.name: Bride and Groom Age Proof (Aadhaar / 10th Marksheet / Birth Certificate)
documents.why: Verifies minimum statutory age.

documents.name: Income Certificate (Below ₹2 Lakh)
documents.why: Confirms income benchmark.

documents.name: Domicile / Resident Certificate of Uttar Pradesh
documents.why: Proves UP domicile.

documents.name: Bride's Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
documents.why: For ₹35,000 DBT cash transfer.

applicationMode: Online via shadianudan.upsdc.gov.in & Offline via Block Development Office / Urban Local Body
process: Step 1: Visit shadianudan.upsdc.gov.in at least 45 to 60 days before the scheduled community wedding event.
Step 2: Register under 'Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana'.
Step 3: Enter bride, groom, and family details along with Aadhaar numbers and bank details.
Step 4: Block Development Officer (rural) or Sub-Divisional Magistrate (urban) verifies documents and approves.
Step 5: Couple participates in the official grand community wedding ceremony.
Step 6: Marriage certificate is issued on the spot; ₹35,000 is transferred via DBT to the bride's bank account.
offlineProcess: Submit application at your Block Development Office (BDO) in rural areas or Executive Officer (Nagar Palika/Nagar Nigam) in urban areas.
commonMistakes: Applying after private marriage has already taken place (scheme requires participation in the organized mass wedding).
Bank account of bride not active or not seeded with Aadhaar.
openingDate: Continuous year-round enrollment aligned with mass wedding schedules
processingTime: 15 to 30 days for verification prior to scheduled event
renewalRequired: One-time scheme
trackingProcedure: Track status on shadianudan.upsdc.gov.in using application number.
correctionProcedure: Contact District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO) to rectify details.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Bride's Bank Account + On-Site Gift Handover
disbursementDetails: ₹35,000 deposited electronically into bride's savings account; ₹10,000 household gift kit presented on-site at the ceremony.

faqs.q: Can widows or divorcees remarry under this scheme?
faqs.a: Yes. Widows, destitute, and legally divorced women remarrying are fully eligible.

helpline: UP Social Welfare Toll-Free: 1800-419-0001 / CM Helpline: 1076

name: Gatidhara Scheme (West Bengal)
title: Gatidhara Scheme (West Bengal)
department: Transport Department, Government of West Bengal
targetBeneficiary: Unemployed youth registered with employment banks in West Bengal
description: Financial subsidy of 30% of commercial vehicle cost up to ₹1,00,000 (and ₹1,50,000 for women) for unemployed youth purchasing taxis, auto-rickshaws, pickups, or e-rickshaws.
detailedDescription: Gatidhara is a flagship self-employment program implemented by the West Bengal Transport Department. It enables registered unemployed youth to buy small commercial transport vehicles (auto-rickshaws, battery totos, taxis, light commercial mini-trucks, ambulances) to earn an independent livelihood. The state government provides a non-repayable capital subsidy of 30% of the ex-showroom vehicle cost up to ₹1,00,000 (enhanced to ₹1,50,000 for women drivers), with the remaining funded via commercial bank loans.
purpose: Generates independent transport livelihoods for unemployed youth, expands rural and urban feeder transit networks, and advances SDG 8.
benefits: Direct government capital grant/subsidy of up to ₹1,00,000 (₹1,50,000 for women) towards vehicle down-payment, with facilitated bank loan tie-up.
financialBenefit: Capital subsidy of 30% of vehicle cost up to ₹1,00,000 (₹1.5 Lakh for women)
benefitFrequency: One-time self-employment grant
impact: Over 52,000 commercial vehicles financed, turning thousands of unemployed youths into self-reliant commercial transport operators.
specificAdvantages: Commercial transport permit issued on fast-track basis upon subsidy approval.

detailedEligibility.ageRequirement: 20 to 45 years (up to 50 years for SC/ST/OBC/Persons with Disabilities).
detailedEligibility.genderRequirement: All genders eligible (higher subsidy for women).
detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Family income up to ₹25,000 per month (₹3,00,000/year).
detailedEligibility.occupationRequirement: Unemployed youth registered in West Bengal Employment Bank (Yuvasree).
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Only one member per family is eligible.

mandatoryConditions: Must be registered with the West Bengal Employment Bank portal (employmentbankwb.gov.in)
Must possess a valid commercial Driving License (LMV-TR / Auto / Commercial badge)
Applicant must have no other commercial transport permit registered in their name
ineligibility: Persons already owning a commercial vehicle or transport permit
Defaulters of prior government loans

documents.name: Valid Commercial Driving License (DL)
documents.why: Proves driving competency for commercial vehicle.

documents.name: Employment Bank Registration Card (Yuvasree)
documents.why: Confirms registered unemployed youth status.

documents.name: Income Certificate & Residential Proof
documents.why: Confirms income below ₹3 Lakh.

documents.name: Vehicle Proforma Invoice / Quotation
documents.why: Specifies ex-showroom vehicle cost.

applicationMode: Online via employmentbankwb.gov.in & Offline at Regional Transport Office (RTO)
process: Step 1: Register on employmentbankwb.gov.in if not already enrolled.
Step 2: Obtain a vehicle quotation for your chosen commercial vehicle (auto, taxi, toto, mini-truck) from an authorized dealer.
Step 3: Submit Gatidhara application online or through your local RTO / SDO office.
Step 4: Regional Transport Authority (RTA) board interviews the applicant and approves the subsidy sanction.
Step 5: Government credits the 30% subsidy (up to ₹1 Lakh/₹1.5 Lakh) directly to the vehicle financier/bank.
Step 6: RTO issues commercial permit and vehicle is handed over to the driver.
offlineProcess: Submit application form at the office of the Regional Transport Officer (RTO) or District Magistrate (Transport Section).
commonMistakes: Not having a valid commercial driving license before applying.
Purchasing a non-commercial private registration vehicle.
processingTime: 30 to 45 days for committee scrutiny and bank sanction
renewalRequired: One-time subsidy
trackingProcedure: Track application status on transport.wb.gov.in or through the RTO office.
correctionProcedure: Contact RTO officer to revise vehicle model or dealership quotation.
disbursementMethod: Direct credit of subsidy into lending bank / vehicle dealer account
disbursementDetails: State Government transfers the subsidy directly to the auto dealer or lending bank to deduct from the purchase cost. Balance financed via commercial loan.

faqs.q: What is the maximum subsidy for women?
faqs.a: Women entrepreneurs receive an enhanced subsidy of 30% up to ₹1,50,000.

faqs.q: Can battery e-rickshaws (Totos) be financed?
faqs.a: Yes, approved electric battery e-rickshaws are covered under Gatidhara.

name: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu Scheme (Telangana)
title: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu Scheme (Telangana)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana
targetBeneficiary: All agricultural landowning farmers and tenant cultivators in Telangana
description: Agricultural investment support providing ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 per acre per year directly into farmers' bank accounts for purchasing seeds, fertilizers, and farm inputs.
detailedDescription: Pioneered in Telangana and inspiring PM-KISAN, Rythu Bandhu (Rythu Bharosa) provides direct cash investment support per acre to free farmers from private usury and moneylender exploitation. The state government transfers seasonal assistance (₹5,000 to ₹7,500 per acre for Kharif and Rabi seasons) directly into landholding farmers' bank accounts through the Dharani land portal. Farmers use these funds at the beginning of the cropping season for seeds, fertilizers, tractor hire, and labor.
purpose: Ensures farmers have ready cash for seasonal inputs, prevents distress borrowing at exorbitant interest rates, and boosts agricultural productivity, supporting SDG 2.
benefits: Direct financial cash assistance of ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 per acre per year transferred straight via DBT into the farmer's bank account twice a year.
financialBenefit: ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 per acre per year direct cash assistance (no upper acre cap)
benefitFrequency: Biannual (Kharif season and Rabi season installments)
impact: Has benefited over 65 lakh farmers in Telangana, dramatically reducing agrarian indebtedness and suicides across rural districts.
specificAdvantages: No application process needed once land title is registered on the Dharani portal; automatic seasonal DBT credits.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: No income limit; open to all agricultural pattadars.
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: Open to all categories.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: Must own agricultural land registered with a valid Pattadar Passbook.

mandatoryConditions: Must own agricultural land in Telangana recorded in the Dharani Land Portal
Must possess an active Pattadar Passbook with passbook number
Bank account must be seeded with Aadhaar
ineligibility: Non-agricultural lands and commercial real estate layouts
Lands under legal title disputes

documents.name: Pattadar Passbook / Dharani Record of Rights
documents.why: Proves land ownership acreage.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Biometric identification.

documents.name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account Passbook
documents.why: For receiving seasonal DBT credits.

applicationMode: Automatic integration via Dharani Portal & Village Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO)
process: Step 1: Ensure your agricultural land is registered on the Dharani portal (dharani.telangana.gov.in).
Step 2: Collect your new Pattadar Passbook with digital land records.
Step 3: Meet the Village Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) to verify your Aadhaar-linked bank details.
Step 4: Agriculture Department verifies acreage and generates the seasonal treasury scroll.
Step 5: Investment assistance is deposited directly into your bank account via e-Kuber / RBI DBT before sowing begins.
offlineProcess: Meet your local Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) at the Rythu Vedika in your village cluster.
commonMistakes: Bank account not mapped to Aadhaar, causing seasonal DBT credits to bounce.
Not updating Pattadar passbook after land sale or family partition.
openingDate: Operates continuously; funds released at the start of Kharif (June) and Rabi (December)
processingTime: Direct release during seasonal government distribution cycles
renewalRequired: Automatic seasonal continuation
trackingProcedure: Track payment status on rythubandhu.telangana.gov.in by entering your PPB Number.
correctionProcedure: Update bank details with your Village Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) or at the local Rythu Vedika.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) via RBI e-Kuber / State Treasury to Bank Account
disbursementDetails: Funds transferred electronically via RBI e-Kuber directly into the beneficiary farmer's account.

faqs.q: Is there a ceiling on acreage?
faqs.a: Investment assistance is paid on all cultivated agricultural land owned by the pattadar.

faqs.q: Do farmers need to repay this money?
faqs.a: No. This is a 100% non-repayable seasonal agricultural investment grant.

helpline: Rythu Bandhu Toll-Free Helpline: 040-23383520 / Kisan Call Centre: 1800-180-1551

name: YSR Cheyutha Scheme (Andhra Pradesh)
title: YSR Cheyutha Scheme (Andhra Pradesh)
department: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Andhra Pradesh
targetBeneficiary: Women aged 45 to 60 belonging to SC, ST, BC, and Minority communities in Andhra Pradesh
description: Financial assistance of ₹18,750 per year (total ₹75,000 over 4 years) transferred directly via DBT to SC, ST, BC, and Minority women aged 45-60 for sustainable enterprise and livelihood creation.
detailedDescription: YSR Cheyutha is an impactful women economic empowerment initiative in Andhra Pradesh. Women aged 45-60 years belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Backward Classes, and Minority communities who are too young for standard senior citizen pensions receive ₹18,750 per year for 4 continuous years (totaling ₹75,000) directly into their bank accounts. In partnership with ITC, Amul, Procter & Gamble, and Reliance, beneficiaries are supported in establishing micro-enterprises like retail grocery, dairy cattle farming, and poultry units.
purpose: Empowers middle-aged women from marginalized castes with independent financial liquidity and sustainable enterprise assets, advancing SDG 5 and SDG 8.
benefits: Direct cash assistance of ₹18,750 per year for 4 years (total ₹75,000) credited via unencumbered DBT into the woman's savings bank account, with zero bank loan deductions.
financialBenefit: ₹18,750 per year (Total ₹75,000 over 4 years) direct cash grant
benefitFrequency: Annual Direct Benefit Transfer
impact: Over 26 lakh women have benefited, with over 10 lakh women successfully establishing flourishing village retail, dairy, and grocery enterprises.
specificAdvantages: Unencumbered cash grant: commercial banks are strictly prohibited from adjusting this money against any past family debts or interest.

detailedEligibility.incomeLimit: Total family income less than ₹10,000/month (rural) or ₹12,000/month (urban).
detailedEligibility.casteCategoryRequirement: SC, ST, BC (Backward Classes), or Minority communities only.
detailedEligibility.familyConditions: No family member can be a government employee or income tax payer.

mandatoryConditions: Woman must be between 45 and 60 years of age verified via Aadhaar
Must belong to SC, ST, BC, or Minority communities holding a valid Integrated Caste Certificate
Total family income below ₹1,20,000/yr (rural) or ₹1,44,000/yr (urban)
Landholding must be under 3 acres wetland or 10 acres dryland
ineligibility: Women who have completed 60 years of age (transferred to YSR Pension Kanuka Old Age Pension)
Households owning a four-wheeler (except taxis/autos/tractors)
Families where any member is a government employee or pensioner

documents.name: Integrated Caste Certificate
documents.why: Confirms SC, ST, BC, or Minority status.

documents.name: Income Certificate / Rice Card
documents.why: Proves low-income status.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.why: Age and biometric verification.

documents.name: Unencumbered Savings Bank Account Passbook
documents.why: For receiving ₹18,750 annual DBT grant.

applicationMode: Doorstep survey via Grama/Ward Sachivalayam & Village Volunteers
process: Step 1: Your local Village / Ward Volunteer conducts a doorstep biometric survey.
Step 2: Submit copies of your Aadhaar, Rice card, and Caste certificate.
Step 3: Welfare and Education Assistant (WEA) verifies documents at the Village Secretariat.
Step 4: Social audit list is published at the Grama Sachivalayam for public verification.
Step 5: Municipal Commissioner / MPDO approves eligible list.
Step 6: ₹18,750 is transferred directly into the woman's bank account via AP State DBT.
offlineProcess: Visit your local Grama Sachivalayam (Village Secretariat) or Ward Secretariat and meet the Welfare and Education Assistant.
commonMistakes: Age on Aadhaar not matching 45-60 year window.
Bank account not active or Aadhaar not NPCI mapped.
openingDate: Annual enrollment cycles verified through Navasakam portal in June-July
processingTime: 15 to 20 days following village secretariat social audit
renewalRequired: Annual continuation subject to remaining under 60 years of age
trackingProcedure: Track application status on gsws.ap.gov.in or inquire at the local Village Secretariat.
correctionProcedure: Submit correction request through your Village Volunteer or Grama Sachivalayam.
disbursementMethod: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Woman's Unencumbered Bank Account
disbursementDetails: Transferred directly from AP State Treasury into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

faqs.q: Can women use this money for business?
faqs.a: Yes. Beneficiaries are encouraged to tie up with Amul, ITC, and retail brands to establish micro-businesses, but cash usage is flexible.

faqs.q: What happens when the woman turns 60?
faqs.a: She automatically transitions to the YSR Pension Kanuka Old Age Pension (₹3,000/month).

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana / Chiranjeevi (Rajasthan)
title: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana / Chiranjeevi (Rajasthan)
